        if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;

        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) && victim->pIndexData->difficulty != 0 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Hitplus cannot be set on prototype mobs with a preset difficulty." );
            return;
        }

        if ( value < 0 || value > 1000000000 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Hitpoint bonus range is 0 to 1 billion." );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            victim->pIndexData->hitplus = value;
            save_mob( victim->pIndexData, true );
        }

        save_char_obj( victim, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "damnumdie" ) )
    {
        if ( !IS_NPC( victim ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Mobiles only." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;

        if ( value < 0 || value > 100 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Number of damage dice range is 0 to 100." );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            victim->pIndexData->damnodice = value;
            save_mob( victim->pIndexData, true );
        }

        save_char_obj( victim, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "damsizedie" ) )
    {
        if ( !IS_NPC( victim ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Mobiles only." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;

        if ( value < 0 || value > 100 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Damage dice size range is 0 to 100." );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            victim->pIndexData->damsizedice = value;
            save_mob( victim->pIndexData, true );
        }

        save_char_obj( victim, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "damplus" ) )
    {
        if ( !IS_NPC( victim ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Mobiles only." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;

        if ( value < 0 || value > 1000 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Damage bonus range is 0 to 1000." );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            victim->pIndexData->damplus = value;
            save_mob( victim->pIndexData, true );
        }

        save_char_obj( victim, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "speaks" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;
        
        victim->speaks = set_flags( ch, languages, victim->speaks, argument, true );

        if ( !IS_NPC( victim ) )
        {
            for ( int i = 0; languages[i].flag != LAST_FLAG_VALUE; i++ )
                if ( victim->race->language == languages[i].flag )
                    xSET_BIT( victim->speaks, victim->race->language );
        }
        else if ( xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            victim->pIndexData->speaks = victim->speaks;
            save_mob( victim->pIndexData, true );
        }

        save_char_obj( victim, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "speaking" ) )
    {
        if ( !IS_NPC( victim ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Players must choose the language they speak themselves." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;
        
        victim->speaking = set_flags( ch, languages, victim->speaking, argument, true );
        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            victim->pIndexData->speaking = victim->speaking;
            save_mob( victim->pIndexData, true );
        }

        save_char_obj( victim, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "vars" ) )
    {
        if ( IS_NPC( victim ) && !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
            return;

        if ( process_setdvar( ch, victim->vars, argument, "mset <&wvictim&C> vars" ) )
        {
            save_char_obj( victim, true );
            ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        }

        return;
    }

    LUA_PARAM params[] =
    {
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_CHAR, .payload = victim},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_STRING, .payload = arg2},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_STRING, .payload = argument},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST}
    };

    if ( lua_hook_subcmd( find_command( "mset" ), ch, cmd, params ) )
        return;

    /*
        Generate usage message.
    */
    if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
    {
        ch->substate = SUB_RESTRICTED;
        interpret( ch, origarg, FALSE );
        ch->substate = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        ch->last_cmd = do_mset;
    }
    else
        do_mset( ch, "" );

    return;
}

CMDF do_oset( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg1 [MIL], arg2 [MIL], arg3 [MIL], arg4 [MIL];
    char buf  [MSL], buf2 [MSL];
    char outbuf  [MSL];
    OBJ_DATA* obj;
    EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed;
    char* origarg = argument;
    int value, tmp;
    BUFFER_DATA* buffer = NULL;

    if ( argument )
        snprintf( buf2, MSL, "%s", argument );

    send_to_char( "&W", ch );

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Mob's can't oset" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !ch->desc )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You have no descriptor" );
        return;
    }

    switch ( ch->substate )
    {
        default:
            break;

        case SUB_OBJ_EXTRA:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            if ( buffer )
            {
                ed = buffer->ed;
                obj = buffer->obj;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }
            else
            {
                bug( "%s: NULL buffer", FUNC );
                ch->substate = SUB_NONE;
                return;
            }
            
            /*  If we get here, it means the user is editing and customizing one specific, so we shouldn't edit the descs for every other ED.
                Otherwise, if the user isn't modifying a single custom ED, they're editing the entire object desc -- so edit every ED to match
                while being careful not to overwrite custom EDs. It's a delicate balance... */
            if ( ed->custom_ed )
                SET_STRING( ed->description, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            else
            {
                EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed2 = ed;
                ed2 = ed2->prev;

                do
                {
                    if ( !ed->custom_ed )
                        SET_STRING( ed->description, copy_buffer( ch ) );

                    ed = ed->next;
                } while ( ed != ed2 );
            }

            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            return;

        case SUB_OBJ_LONG:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            if ( buffer )
            {
                obj = buffer->obj;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }
            else
            {
                bug( "%s: NULL buffer", FUNC );
                ch->substate = SUB_NONE;
                return;
            }
            
            if ( !valid_obj( obj ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Your object was extracted!" );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( obj->description, copy_buffer( ch ) );

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->description, obj->description );
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }

            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            return;

        case SUB_OBJ_LPROG:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            if ( buffer )
            {
                obj = buffer->obj;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }
            else
            {
                bug( "%s: NULL buffer", FUNC );
                ch->substate = SUB_NONE;
                return;
            }

            if ( !valid_obj( obj ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Your object was extracted!" );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            OBJ_INDEX_DATA* proto = obj->pIndexData;
            SET_STRING( proto->lprog_code, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            if ( proto->lprog_code != NULL && proto->lprog_code[0] == '\0' )
                SET_STRING( proto->lprog_code, NULL );
                
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            save_persistent_object( obj, true );
            ch_println( ch, "&WObject lua code %s.", proto->lprog_code != NULL ? "set" : "cleared" );
            LUA_PROGRAM* pLprog = get_obj_proto_lprog( proto );

            if ( pLprog )
                lua_program_dispose( pLprog );
            
            if ( !NULLSTR( proto->lprog_code ) )
            {
                LUA_PARAM params[] =
                {
                    { .type = LUA_PARAM_OBJ_PROTO, .payload = ( void* ) proto, .global_name = "self"},
                    { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST }
                };
                // the debugger will see the output from loading the buffer, and then be unset
                // so they don't stay set. we don't have enough safety in place for that yet
                // ~Miros
                pLprog = lua_clear_debugger( lua_load_from_buffer( obj_proto_lprog_identifier( proto ), proto->lprog_code, ch, params ) );
                pLprog->obj = proto;
            }

            return;
    }

    obj = NULL;
    smash_tilde( argument );

    if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
    {
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( buffer )
            obj = buffer->obj;
        else
        {
            bug( "%s: NULL buffer", FUNC );
            ch->substate = SUB_NONE;
            return;
        }
        
        if ( !valid_obj( obj ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Your object was extracted!" );
            obj = NULL;
            argument = "done";
        }

        if ( argument[0] == '\0' || !str_cmp( argument, " " )
                ||   !str_cmp( argument, "stat" ) )
        {
            if ( obj )
                do_ostat( ch, obj->name );
            else
                ch_println( ch, "No object selected.  Type '?' for help." );

            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( argument, "done" ) || !str_cmp( argument, "off" ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Oset mode off." );
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            dispose_buffer( buffer );
            ch->substate = SUB_NONE;

            if ( ch->pcdata && ch->pcdata->subprompt )
                SET_STRING( ch->pcdata->subprompt, NULL );

            return;
        }
    }

    if ( obj )
    {
        strlcpy( arg1, obj->name, MIL );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
        strlcpy( arg3, argument, MIL );
    }
    else
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
        strlcpy( arg3, argument, MIL );
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "on" ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C|&wvnum&C> on.&w" );
        return;
    }

    if ( arg1[0] == '\0' || arg2[0] == '\0' || !str_cmp( arg1, "?" ) )
    {
        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
        {
            if ( obj )
                ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &C<&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
            else
                ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &C<&wobject&C> <&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
        }
        else
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> <&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w\n" );

        ch_println( ch, "&zField being one of:" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  flags wear level weight cost rent timer" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  name short long desc ed rmed actiondesc" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  type value0 value1 value2 value3 value4 value5 vars" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  affect rmaffect layers blueprint clan lprog" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor weapons: &Bweapontype, condition, mindam," );
        ch_println( ch, "&z             &Bmaxdam, charges, maxcharges" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor armor: &Bac, condition" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor devices: &Bslevel, spell, maxcharges, charges" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor containers: &Bcflags, key, capacity" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor levers&w/&zswitches: &Btflags" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor rawspice: &Bspicetype, grade" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor ammo&w/&zbattery: &Bcharges (at least 1000 for ammo)" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor crystals: &Bgemtype, weapontype" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor comlinks: &Bcflags" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zFor cyber parts: &Bcybertype" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !obj && get_trust( ch ) <= LEVEL_IMMORTAL )
    {
        if ( ( obj = get_obj_here( ch, arg1 ) ) == NULL )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can't find that here." );
            return;
        }
    }
    else if ( !obj )
    {
        if ( ( obj = get_obj_world( ch, arg1 ) ) == NULL )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "There is nothing like that in all the realms." );
            return;
        }
    }

    if ( !xIS_SET( obj->extra_flags, ITEM_PROTOTYPE )
            && get_trust( ch ) < ( MAX_IMM_LEVEL - 6 )
            && !is_name( "objects", ch->pcdata->bestowments ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You can only modify PROTOTYPE objects." );
        return;
    }

    separate_obj( obj );
    value = atoi( arg3 );

    if ( !xIS_SET( obj->extra_flags, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        add_mset( ch, buf2, get_trust( ch ), "Object" );

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "on" ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Oset mode on. (Editing '%s' vnum %d).",
                   obj->name, obj->pIndexData->vnum );
        ch->substate = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->obj = obj;

        if ( ch->pcdata )
        {
            snprintf( buf, MSL, "<&COset &W#%d&w> %%i", obj->pIndexData->vnum );
            SET_STRING( ch->pcdata->subprompt, buf );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( get_trust( ch ) >= LEVEL_ADMIN || is_name( "values", ch->pcdata->bestowments ) )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "value0" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "v0" ) )
        {
            if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
                return;

            obj->value[0] = value;

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                obj->pIndexData->value[0] = value;
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }

            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "value1" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "v1" ) )
        {
            if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
                return;

            obj->value[1] = value;

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                obj->pIndexData->value[1] = value;
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }

            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "value2" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "v2" ) )
        {
            if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
                return;

            obj->value[2] = value;

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                obj->pIndexData->value[2] = value;
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );

                if ( obj->item_type == ITEM_WEAPON && value != 0 )
                    obj->value[2] = obj->pIndexData->value[1] * obj->pIndexData->value[2];
            }

            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "value3" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "v3" ) )
        {
            if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
                return;

            obj->value[3] = value;

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
                obj->pIndexData->value[3] = value;

            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "value4" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "v4" ) )
        {
            if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
                return;

            obj->value[4] = value;

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                obj->pIndexData->value[4] = value;
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }

            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "value5" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "v5" ) )
        {
            if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
                return;

            obj->value[5] = value;

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                obj->pIndexData->value[5] = value;
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }

            return;
        }
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "type" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> type <&wtype&C>&w" );
            ch_println( ch, "&zPossible Types:" );
            ch_println( ch, "%s", flag_options_descs( obj_types ) );
            return;
        }

        value = get_flag( argument, obj_types );

        if ( value == FLAG_UNDEFINED || value == ITEM_NONE )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Unknown type: %s", arg3 );
            return;
        }

        obj->item_type = ( sh_int ) value;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->item_type = obj->item_type;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "flags" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        bool was_proto = xIS_SET( obj->extra_flags, ITEM_PROTOTYPE );
        EXT_BV new_flags = set_flags( ch, obj_flags, obj->extra_flags, argument, false );
        if ( !xSAME_BIT( obj->extra_flags, new_flags, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) && get_trust( ch ) < ( MAX_IMM_LEVEL - 6 ) && !is_name( "proto", ch->pcdata->bestowments ) )
            ch_println( ch, "You need to be an administrator or get the proto bestowment to toggle the prototype flag." );
        else
        {
            print_flags_set_results( ch, obj_flags, obj->extra_flags, new_flags );
            obj->extra_flags = new_flags;
            if ( was_proto || xIS_SET( new_flags, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                obj->pIndexData->extra_flags = new_flags;
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "wear" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;
        
        obj->wear_flags = set_flags( ch, wear_types, obj->wear_flags, argument, true );
        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->wear_flags = obj->wear_flags;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "level" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        obj->level = value;
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "weight" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        obj->weight = value;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->weight = value;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "cost" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        obj->cost = value;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->cost = value;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "rent" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->rent = value;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }
        else
            ch_println( ch, "The item must have the prototype flag to set this value." );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "layers" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->layers = value;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }
        else
            ch_println( ch, "The item must have the prototype flag to set this value." );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "timer" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        obj->timer = value;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->timer = value;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "blueprint" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        SET_STRING( obj->blueprint, arg3 );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->blueprint, obj->blueprint );
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "cybertype" ) )
    {
        CYBER_TYPE_DATA* cyber = NULL;

        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        if ( obj->item_type != ITEM_CYBER )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Sorry, cybertype is for cybernetics only." );
            return;
        }

        cyber = get_cyber( arg3 );

        if ( argument[0] != '\0' && !cyber )
        {
            send_to_char( "&zNo such cyber type exists.&w\n"
                          , ch );
            return;
        }

        SET_STRING( obj->cybertype, arg3 );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->cybertype, obj->cybertype );
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "clan" ) )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        SET_STRING( obj->obj_clan, arg3 );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->obj_clan, obj->obj_clan );
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "name" ) )
    {
        char description_placeholder[MSL];

        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        if ( NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&WYou &RMUST choose a new name" );
            return;
        }

        SET_STRING( obj->name, arg3 );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->name, obj->name );
            ed = SetOExtraProtoCustom( obj->pIndexData, obj->name, FALSE );
            ed = obj->pIndexData->first_extradesc;
        }
        else
        {
            ed = SetOExtraCustom( obj, obj->name, FALSE );
            ed = obj->first_extradesc;
        }

        /* Find the first real description in a non-custom extradesc and hold onto it */
        for ( ; ed; ed = ed->next )
        {
            if ( ed->description != NULL && strcmp( ed->description, "" ) && !ed->custom_ed )
            {
                strlcpy( description_placeholder, ed->description, MSL );
                break;
            }
        }

        /* For every empty extradesc (typically the ones we just autocreated when we changed the name), set their descs */
        if ( !NULLSTR( description_placeholder ) )
            for ( ; ed; ed = ed->next )
                if ( ed->description != NULL && !strcmp( ed->description, "" ) && !ed->custom_ed )
                    SET_STRING( ed->description, description_placeholder );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "short" ) )
    {
        strlcat( arg3, "&D", MIL );
        SET_STRING( obj->short_descr, arg3 );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->short_descr, obj->short_descr );
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }
        else
            /*  Feature added by Narn, Apr/96
                If the item is not proto, add the word 'rename' to the keywords
                if it is not already there.
            */
        {
            if ( str_infix( "rename", obj->name ) )
            {
                snprintf( buf, MSL, "%s %s", obj->name, "rename" );
                SET_STRING( obj->name, buf );
            }
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "actiondesc" ) )
    {
        if ( strstr( arg3, "%n" )
                ||   strstr( arg3, "%d" )
                ||   strstr( arg3, "%l" ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Illegal characters!" );
            return;
        }

        SET_STRING( obj->action_desc, arg3 );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->action_desc, obj->action_desc );
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "long" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( arg3[0] )
        {
            SET_STRING( obj->description, arg3 );

            if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            {
                SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->description, obj->description );
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }

            return;
        }

        CHECK_SUBRESTRICTED( ch );

        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch->tempnum = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        else
            ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;

        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->obj = obj;

        ch->substate = SUB_OBJ_LONG;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, obj->description );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "affect" ) )
    {
        AFFECT_DATA* paf;
        sh_int loc;
        EXT_BV aff_bitvector;
        xCLEAR_BITS( aff_bitvector );
        value = 0;
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
        if ( NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> affect <&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
            ch_println( ch, "&zAffect Fields:" );
            ch_println( ch, "&Bnone        strength    dexterity   intelligence  wisdom       constitution" );
            ch_println( ch, "&Bsex         level       age         height        weight       force" );
            ch_println( ch, "&Bhit         move        credits     experience    armor        hitroll" );
            ch_println( ch, "&Bdamroll     save_para   save_rod    save_poison   save_breath  save_power" );
            ch_println( ch, "&Bcharisma    resistant   immune      susceptible   affected     luck" );
            return;
        }

        loc = get_atype( arg2 );
        if ( loc < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Unknown field: %s", arg2 );
            return;
        }

        if ( loc == APPLY_AFFECT )
        {
            aff_bitvector = set_flags( ch, affect_flags, aff_bitvector, argument, true );
            value = 0;
            if ( xIS_EMPTY( aff_bitvector ) )
                return;
        }
        else if ( loc == APPLY_RESISTANT || loc == APPLY_IMMUNE || loc == APPLY_SUSCEPTIBLE )
        {
            const FLAG_INFO* ris_flag = flag_from_name( resistant_types, argument );
            if ( !ris_flag )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Unknown flag: %s", arg3 );
                return;
            }
            value = ris_flag->flag;
        }
        else
        {
            if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> affect <&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
                return;
            }
            argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
            value = atoi( arg3 );
        }

        CREATE( paf, AFFECT_DATA, 1 );
        paf->type            = -1;
        paf->duration        = -1;
        paf->location        = loc;
        paf->modifier        = value;
        xCLEAR_BITS( paf->bitvector );
        xSET_BITS( paf->bitvector, aff_bitvector );
        paf->next = NULL;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            if ( loc != APPLY_WEARSPELL && loc != APPLY_REMOVESPELL && loc != APPLY_STRIPSN && loc != APPLY_WEAPONSPELL )
            {
                CHAR_DATA* vch = NULL;
                OBJ_DATA* eq = NULL;

                for ( vch = first_char; vch; vch = vch->next )
                {
                    for ( eq = vch->first_carrying; eq; eq = eq->next_content )
                    {
                        if ( eq->pIndexData == obj->pIndexData && eq->wear_loc != WEAR_NONE )
                            affect_modify( vch, CHAR_AFFECT, paf, TRUE );
                    }
                }
            }

            LINK( paf, obj->pIndexData->first_affect, obj->pIndexData->last_affect, next, prev );
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }
        else
            LINK( paf, obj->first_affect, obj->last_affect, next, prev );

        ++top_affect;
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "rmaffect" ) )
    {
        AFFECT_DATA* paf, *next_paf;
        sh_int loc, count;

        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> rmaffect <&waffect &z#&C>&w" );
            return;
        }

        loc = atoi( argument );

        if ( loc < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Invalid number." );
            return;
        }

        count = 0;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            OBJ_INDEX_DATA* pObjIndex;
            pObjIndex = obj->pIndexData;

            for ( paf = pObjIndex->first_affect; paf; paf = next_paf )
            {
                next_paf = paf->next;

                if ( ++count == loc )
                {
                    UNLINK( paf, pObjIndex->first_affect, pObjIndex->last_affect, next, prev );

                    if ( paf->location != APPLY_WEARSPELL && paf->location != APPLY_REMOVESPELL && paf->location != APPLY_STRIPSN
                            && paf->location != APPLY_WEAPONSPELL )
                    {
                        CHAR_DATA* vch;
                        OBJ_DATA* eq;

                        for ( vch = first_char; vch; vch = vch->next )
                        {
                            for ( eq = vch->first_carrying; eq; eq = eq->next_content )
                            {
                                if ( eq->pIndexData == pObjIndex && eq->wear_loc != WEAR_NONE )
                                    affect_modify( vch, CHAR_AFFECT, paf, FALSE );
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    FREE_STRUCT_NORET( paf, affect_fields );
                    ch_println( ch, "Removed." );
                    --top_affect;
                    save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        else
        {
            for ( paf = obj->first_affect; paf; paf = next_paf )
            {
                next_paf = paf->next;

                if ( ++count == loc )
                {
                    UNLINK( paf, obj->first_affect, obj->last_affect, next, prev );
                    FREE_STRUCT_NORET( paf, affect_fields );
                    ch_println( ch, "Removed." );
                    --top_affect;
                    return;
                }
            }

            ch_println( ch, "Not found." );
            return;
        }
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "vars" ) )
    {
        process_setdvar( ch, obj->vars, argument, "oset <&wobject&C> vars" );

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "ed" ) )
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );

        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> ed <&wkeyword&C>&w" );
            return;
        }

        if ( !NULLSTR( arg4 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can only edit one custom ed keyword at a time.&w" );
            return;
        }

        CHECK_SUBRESTRICTED( ch );

        if ( obj->timer )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "It's not safe to edit an extra description on an object with a timer.\nTurn it off first." );
            return;
        }

        if ( obj->item_type == ITEM_DISK )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can not add an extra description to a message disk." );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            ed = SetOExtraProtoCustom( obj->pIndexData, arg3, TRUE );
        else
            ed = SetOExtraCustom( obj, arg3, TRUE );

        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch->tempnum = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        else
            ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;

        ch->substate = SUB_OBJ_EXTRA;
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->obj = obj;
        buffer->ed = ed;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, ed->description );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "desc" ) || !str_cmp( arg2, "description" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        CHECK_SUBRESTRICTED( ch );

        if ( obj->timer )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "It's not safe to edit a description on an object with a timer.\nTurn it off first." );
            return;
        }

        if ( obj->item_type == ITEM_DISK )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can not add a description to a message disk." );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
            ed = SetOExtraProtoCustom( obj->pIndexData, obj->name, FALSE );
        else
            ed = SetOExtraCustom( obj, obj->name, FALSE );

        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch->tempnum = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        else
            ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;

        ch->substate = SUB_OBJ_EXTRA;
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->ed = ed;
        buffer->obj = obj;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, ed->description );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "rmed" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Coset <&wobject&C> rmed <&wkeywords&C>&w" );
            return;
        }

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            if ( DelOExtraProto( obj->pIndexData, arg3 ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Deleted." );
                save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
            }
            else
                ch_println( ch, "Not found." );

            return;
        }

        if ( DelOExtra( obj, arg3 ) )
            ch_println( ch, "Deleted." );
        else
            ch_println( ch, "Not found." );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "lprog" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( obj->timer )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "It's not safe to edit the lprog on an object with a timer.\nTurn it off first." );
            return;
        }

        ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;
        ch->substate = SUB_OBJ_LPROG;
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->obj = obj;
        if ( !obj->pIndexData->lprog_code )
            SET_STRING( obj->pIndexData->lprog_code, "" );
        start_editing_lua( ch, FUNC, obj->pIndexData->lprog_code, LUA_PARAM_OBJ_PROTO, obj->pIndexData );
        return;
    }

    /*
        save some finger-leather
    */
    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "ris" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect resistant %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect immune %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect susceptible %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "r" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect resistant %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "i" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect immune %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "s" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect susceptible %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "ri" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect resistant %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect immune %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "rs" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect resistant %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect susceptible %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "is" ) )
    {
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect immune %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        snprintf( outbuf, MSL, "%s affect susceptible %s", arg1, arg3 );
        do_oset( ch, outbuf );
        return;
    }

    /*
        Make it easier to set special object values by name than number
                               -Thoric
    */
    tmp = -1;

    switch ( obj->item_type )
    {
        case ITEM_BLUEPRINT:
            value = atoi( arg3 );

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "hull" ) )
            {
                tmp = 1;
                break;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "circuits" ) )
            {
                tmp = 2;
                break;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "engines" ) )
            {
                tmp = 4;
                break;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "weapons" ) )
            {
                tmp = 3;
                break;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "time" ) )
            {
                tmp = 0;
                break;
            }

            break;

        case ITEM_WEAPON:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "weapontype" ) )
            {
                value = get_flag( arg3, weapon_table );

                if ( value == FLAG_UNDEFINED )
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "&RUnknown weapon type.&w\n" );
                    ch_println( ch, "&zChoices:" );
                    ch_println( ch, "%s", flag_options_descs( weapon_table ) );
                    return;
                }

                tmp = 3;
                break;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "condition" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "mindam" ) )
                tmp = 1;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "maxdam" ) )
                tmp = 2;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charges" ) )
                tmp = 4;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "maxcharges" ) )
                tmp = 5;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charge" ) )
                tmp = 4;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "maxcharge" ) )
                tmp = 5;

            break;

        case ITEM_BOLT:
        case ITEM_AMMO:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charges" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charge" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            break;

        case ITEM_BATTERY:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charges" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charge" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            break;

        case ITEM_RAWSPICE:
        case ITEM_SPICE:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "grade" ) )
                tmp = 1;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "spicetype" ) )
            {
                value = get_flag( arg3, drug_types );

                if ( value == FLAG_UNDEFINED )
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "&zUnknown spice type.&w" );
                    ch_println( ch, "&zChoices:" );
                    ch_println( ch, "%s", flag_options_descs( drug_types ) );
                    return;
                }

                tmp = 0;
                break;
            }

            break;

        case ITEM_CRYSTAL:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "gemtype" ) )
            {
                value = get_flag( arg3, crystal_table );

                if ( value == FLAG_UNDEFINED )
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "Unknown gem type." );
                    ch_println( ch, "\nChoices:" );
                    ch_println( ch, "%s", flag_options_descs( crystal_table ) );
                    return;
                }

                tmp = 0;
                break;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "weapontype" ) )
            {
                if ( !str_cmp( arg3, "blaster" ) )
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "&zCrystal type set to &Cblaster crystal&z." );
                    obj->value[2] = 0;

                    if ( xIS_SET( obj->extra_flags, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
                    {
                        obj->pIndexData->value[2] = 0;
                        save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
                    }
                }
                else if ( !str_cmp( arg3, "lightsaber" ) || !str_cmp( arg3, "saber" ) )
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "&zCrystal type set to &Clightsaber crystal&z." );
                    obj->value[2] = 1;

                    if ( xIS_SET( obj->extra_flags, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
                    {
                        obj->pIndexData->value[2] = 1;
                        save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "&zYou need to enter either &Cblaster&z or &Clightsaber&z." );
                    return;
                }
            }

            break;

        case ITEM_ARMOR:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "condition" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "ac" )    )
                tmp = 1;

            break;

        case ITEM_PILL:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "slevel" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "spell1" ) )
                tmp = 1;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "spell2" ) )
                tmp = 2;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "spell3" ) )
                tmp = 3;

            if ( tmp >= 1 && tmp <= 3 )
                value = skill_from_name( arg3 )->id;

            break;

        case ITEM_DEVICE:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "slevel" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "spell" ) )
            {
                tmp = 3;
                value = skill_from_name( arg3 )->id;
            }

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "maxcharges" )    )
                tmp = 1;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "charges" ) )
                tmp = 2;

            break;

        case ITEM_CONTAINER:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "capacity" ) )
                tmp = 0;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "cflags" ) )
                tmp = 1;

            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "key" ) )
                tmp = 2;

            break;

        case ITEM_COMLINK:
            if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "cflags" ) )
                tmp = 3;

            break;
    }

    if ( tmp >= 0 && tmp <= 5 )
    {
        if ( !can_omodify( ch, obj ) )
            return;

        obj->value[tmp] = value;

        if ( IS_OBJ_STAT( obj, ITEM_PROTOTYPE ) )
        {
            obj->pIndexData->value[tmp] = value;
            save_object( obj->pIndexData, true );
        }

        return;
    }

    LUA_PARAM params[] =
    {
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_OBJ, .payload = obj},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_STRING, .payload = arg2},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_STRING, .payload = arg3},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST}
    };

    if ( can_omodify( ch, obj ) && lua_hook_subcmd( find_command( "oset" ), ch, origarg, params ) )
        return;

    /*
        Generate usage message.
    */
    if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
    {
        ch->substate = SUB_RESTRICTED;
        interpret( ch, origarg, FALSE );
        ch->substate = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        ch->last_cmd = do_oset;
    }
    else
        do_oset( ch, "" );

    return;
}

/*
    Returns value 0 - 9 based on directional text.
*/
int get_dir( char* txt )
{
    if ( is_number( txt ) && atoi( txt ) >= 0 && atoi( txt ) <= 10 )
        return atoi( txt );

    for ( int i = 0; i <= 10; i++ )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( txt, dir_name[i] ) )
            return i;

        if ( !str_cmp( txt, dir_name_short[i] ) )
            return i;
    }

    return 10;
}

char* sprint_reset( CHAR_DATA* ch, RESET_DATA* pReset, sh_int num, bool rlist )
{
    static char buf[MSL];
    char mobname[MIL];
    char roomname[MIL];
    char objname[MIL];
    strlcpy( buf, "", MSL );
    static ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room;
    static OBJ_INDEX_DATA* obj, *obj2;
    static MOB_INDEX_DATA* mob;
    int rvnum = 0;

    if ( ch->in_room )
        rvnum = ch->in_room->vnum;

    if ( num == 1 )
    {
        room = NULL;
        obj  = NULL;
        obj2 = NULL;
        mob  = NULL;
    }

    switch ( pReset->command )
    {
        default:
            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) *** BAD RESET: %c %d %d %d %d ***\n",
                     num,
                     pReset->command,
                     pReset->extra,
                     pReset->arg1,
                     pReset->arg2,
                     pReset->arg3 );
            break;

        case 'M':
            mob = get_mob_index( pReset->arg1 );
            room = get_room_index( pReset->arg3 );

            if ( mob )
                strlcpy( mobname, mob->player_name, MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( mobname, "Mobile: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );

            if ( room )
                strlcpy( roomname, room->name, MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( roomname, "Room: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) %s (%d) -> %s (%d) [%d]\n",
                      num,
                      mobname,
                      pReset->arg1,
                      roomname,
                      pReset->arg3,
                      pReset->arg2 );
            break;

        case 'E':
            if ( !mob )
                strlcpy( mobname, "* ERROR: NO MOBILE! *", MIL );

            if ( ( obj = get_obj_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( objname, "Object: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( objname, obj->name, MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) %s (%d) -> %s (%s) [%d]\n",
                      num,
                      objname,
                      pReset->arg1,
                      mobname,
                      wear_locs[pReset->arg3],
                      pReset->arg2 );
            break;

        case 'H':
            if ( pReset->arg1 > 0
                    &&  ( obj = get_obj_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( objname, "Object: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else if ( !obj )
                strlcpy( objname, "Object: *NULL obj*", MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) Hide %s (%d)\n",
                      num,
                      objname,
                      obj ? obj->vnum : pReset->arg1 );
            break;

        case 'G':
            if ( !mob )
                strlcpy( mobname, "* ERROR: NO MOBILE! *", MIL );

            if ( ( obj = get_obj_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( objname, "Object: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( objname, obj->name, MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) %s (%d) -> %s (carry) [%d]\n",
                      num,
                      objname,
                      pReset->arg1,
                      mobname,
                      pReset->arg2 );
            break;

        case 'O':
            if ( ( obj = get_obj_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( objname, "Object: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( objname, obj->name, MIL );

            room = get_room_index( pReset->arg3 );

            if ( !room )
                strlcpy( roomname, "Room: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( roomname, room->name, MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) (object) %s (%d) -> %s (%d) [%d]\n",
                      num,
                      objname,
                      pReset->arg1,
                      roomname,
                      pReset->arg3,
                      pReset->arg2 );
            break;

        case 'P':
            if ( ( obj2 = get_obj_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( objname, "Object1: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( objname, obj2->name, MIL );

            if ( pReset->arg3 > 0
                    &&  ( obj = get_obj_index( pReset->arg3 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( roomname, "Object2: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else if ( !obj )
                strlcpy( roomname, "Object2: *NULL obj*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( roomname, obj->name, MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) (Put) %s (%d) -> %s (%d) [%d]\n",
                      num,
                      objname,
                      pReset->arg1,
                      roomname,
                      obj ? obj->vnum : pReset->arg3,
                      pReset->arg2 );
            break;

        case 'D':
            if ( pReset->arg2 < 0 || pReset->arg2 > MAX_DIR + 1 )
                pReset->arg2 = 0;

            if ( ( room = get_room_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
            {
                strlcpy( roomname, "Room: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
                snprintf( objname, MIL, "%s (no exit)",
                         dir_name[pReset->arg2] );
            }
            else
            {
                strlcpy( roomname, room->name, MIL );
                snprintf( objname, MIL, "%s%s",
                         dir_name[pReset->arg2],
                         get_exit( room, pReset->arg2 ) ? "" : " (NO EXIT!)" );
            }

            switch ( pReset->arg3 )
            {
                default:
                    strlcpy( mobname, "(* ERROR *)", MIL );
                    break;

                case 0:
                    strlcpy( mobname, "Open", MIL );
                    break;

                case 1:
                    strlcpy( mobname, "Close", MIL );
                    break;

                case 2:
                    strlcpy( mobname, "Close and lock", MIL );
                    break;
            }

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) %s [%d] the %s [%d] door %s (%d)\n",
                      num,
                      mobname,
                      pReset->arg3,
                      objname,
                      pReset->arg2,
                      roomname,
                      pReset->arg1 );
            break;

        case 'R':
            if ( ( room = get_room_index( pReset->arg1 ) ) == NULL )
                strlcpy( roomname, "Room: *BAD VNUM*", MIL );
            else
                strlcpy( roomname, room->name, MIL );

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) Randomize exits 0 to %d -> %s (%d)\n",
                      num,
                      pReset->arg2,
                      roomname,
                      pReset->arg1 );
            break;

        case 'T':
            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%2d) TRAP: %d %d %d %d\n",
                     num,
                     pReset->extra,
                     pReset->arg1,
                     pReset->arg2,
                     pReset->arg3 );
            break;
    }

    if ( rlist && ( !room || ( room && room->vnum != rvnum ) ) )
        return NULL;

    return buf;
}
void set_bexit_key( EXIT_DATA* pexit, int key )
{
    EXIT_DATA* pexit_rev;
    pexit->key = key;

    if ( ( pexit_rev = pexit->rexit ) != NULL
            &&   pexit_rev != pexit )
        pexit_rev->key = key;
}

CMDF do_redit( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char buf [MSL], arg [MIL], arg2[MIL], arg3[MIL];
    AREA_DATA* pArea = NULL;
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* location = NULL, *tmp = NULL;
    EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed = NULL;
    EXIT_DATA* xit = NULL, *texit = NULL;
    BUFFER_DATA* buffer = NULL;
    char dir;
    int value, edir, ekey, evnum;
    char* origarg = argument;

    if ( !ch->desc )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You have no descriptor." );
        return;
    }

    switch ( ch->substate )
    {
        default:
            break;

        case SUB_NIGHTDESC:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );

            if ( buffer )
            {
                location = buffer->room;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }

            if ( !location )
            {
                bug( "redit: sub_room_desc: NULL buffer", 0 );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( location->nightdesc, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            save_room( location, true );
            return;

        case SUB_STOCKDESC:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );

            if ( buffer )
            {
                location = buffer->room;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }

            if ( !location )
            {
                bug( "redit: sub_room_desc: NULL buffer", 0 );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( location->stockdesc, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            save_room( location, true );
            return;

        case SUB_ROOM_DESC:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );

            if ( buffer )
            {
                location = buffer->room;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }

            if ( !location )
            {
                bug( "redit: sub_room_desc: NULL buffer", 0 );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( location->description, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            save_room( location, true );
            return;

        case SUB_ROOM_EXTRA:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );

            if ( buffer )
            {
                location = buffer->room;
                ed = buffer->ed;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }

            if ( !ed )
            {
                bug( "redit: sub_room_extra: NULL buffer", 0 );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( ed->description, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            save_room( location, true );
            return;

        case SUB_ROOM_LPROG:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );

            if ( buffer )
            {
                location = buffer->room;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }

            if ( !location )
            {
                bug( "redit: sub_room_lprog: NULL buffer", 0 );
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( location->lprog_code, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            ch->substate = ch->tempnum;
            if ( location->lprog_code != NULL && location->lprog_code[0] == '\0' )
                SET_STRING( location->lprog_code, NULL );
            ch_println( ch, "&WRoom lua code %s.", location->lprog_code != NULL ? "set" : "cleared" );
            save_room( location, true );
            LUA_PROGRAM* pLprog = get_room_lprog( location );

            if ( pLprog )
                lua_program_dispose( pLprog );

            if ( !NULLSTR( location->lprog_code ) )
            {
                LUA_PARAM params[] =
                {
                    { .type = LUA_PARAM_ROOM, .payload = ( void* ) location, .global_name = "self"},
                    { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST }
                };
                // the debugger will see the output from loading the buffer, and then be unset
                // so they don't stay set. we don't have enough safety in place for that yet
                // ~Miros
                pLprog = lua_clear_debugger( lua_load_from_buffer( room_lprog_identifier( location ), location->lprog_code, ch, params ) );
                pLprog->room = location;
            }

            return;
    }

    location = ch->in_room;
    smash_tilde( argument );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );

    if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( arg ) )
        {
            do_rstat( ch, "" );
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg, "done" ) || !str_cmp( arg, "off" ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Redit mode off." );

            if ( ch->pcdata && ch->pcdata->subprompt )
                SET_STRING( ch->pcdata->subprompt, NULL );

            ch->substate = SUB_NONE;
            return;
        }
    }

    if ( arg[0] == '\0' || !str_cmp( arg, "?" ) )
    {
        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &C<&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
        else
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit <&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );

        ch_println( ch, "" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zField being one of:" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bname desc ed rmed" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bexit bexit exdesc exflags bexflags" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bexname exkey bexkey flags sector teledelay" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Btelevnum tunnel stockname stockdesc" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bminshipclass maxshipclass shipcapacity xyz" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bdescgpt affected" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_rmodify( ch, location ) )
        return;

    /*
        if ( !str_cmp( arg, "on" ) )
        {
        ch_println( ch, "Redit mode on." );
        ch->substate = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        if ( ch->pcdata )
           SET_STRING( ch->pcdata->subprompt, "<&CRedit &W#%r&w> %i" );
        return;
        }
    */

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "substate" ) )
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "north" )  )
        {
            ch->inter_substate = SUB_NORTH;
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "east" )  )
        {
            ch->inter_substate = SUB_EAST;
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "south" )  )
        {
            ch->inter_substate = SUB_SOUTH;
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "west" )  )
        {
            ch->inter_substate = SUB_WEST;
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "up" )  )
        {
            ch->inter_substate = SUB_UP;
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "down" )  )
        {
            ch->inter_substate = SUB_DOWN;
            return;
        }

        ch_println( ch, " unrecognized substate in redit" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "name" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSet the room name.  A very brief single line room description." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit name <&wRoom summary&C>" );
            return;
        }

        if ( stristr( argument, "{" ) || stristr( argument, "}" ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You cannot use \"{\" or \"}\" tokens in room names." );
            return;
        }

        SET_STRING( location->name, argument );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "stockname" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSet the room stock name. If changed by players, it will be returned to this on ownership being reset." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit stockname <&wname&C>" );
            return;
        }

        SET_STRING( location->stockname, argument );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "desc" ) || !str_cmp( arg, "description" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch->tempnum = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        else
            ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;

        ch->substate = SUB_ROOM_DESC;
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->room = location;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, location->description );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "nightdesc" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch->tempnum = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        else
            ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;

        ch->substate = SUB_NIGHTDESC;
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->room = location;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, location->nightdesc );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "stockdesc" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
            ch->tempnum = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        else
            ch->tempnum = SUB_NONE;

        ch->substate = SUB_STOCKDESC;
        buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->room = location;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, location->stockdesc );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "tunnel" ) )
    {
        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSet the maximum characters allowed in the room at one time. (0 = unlimited)." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit tunnel <&wvalue&C>" );
            return;
        }

        location->tunnel = URANGE( 0, atoi( argument ), 1000 );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "affected" ) )
    {
        EXT_BV new_affected = set_flags( ch, affect_flags, location->affected_by, argument, true );
        location->affected_by = new_affected;
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "minshipclass" ) )
    {
        if ( !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_GARAGE ) && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_CAN_LAND )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_CLANPAD )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_SPACECRAFT )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_HIDDEN_LAND ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can only set minimum ship class in garages or landing pads." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSet the minimum ship class that can be built in this garage or landed on this pad." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit minshipclass <&wvalue&C>" );
            ch_println( ch, "&zClasses:  0 - &CFighter Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          1 - &CTransport Ship    " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          2 - &CFreighter Ship    " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          3 - &CGunboat Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          4 - &CCorvette Ship     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          5 - &CFrigate Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          6 - &CCruiser Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          7 - &CBattleship        " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          8 - &CBattlestation     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          9 - &CShip Platform     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          10  - &CSatellite       " );
            return;
        }

        if ( atoi( argument ) > location->maxshipclass )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Your minimum ship class must be less than or equal to your maximum ship class." );
            return;
        }

        location->minshipclass = URANGE( 0, atoi( argument ), 10 );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "maxshipclass" ) )
    {
        if ( !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_GARAGE ) && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_CAN_LAND )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_CLANPAD )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_SPACECRAFT )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_HIDDEN_LAND ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can only set maximum ship class in garages or landing pads." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSet the maximum ship class that can be built in this garage or landed on this pad." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit maxshipclass <&wvalue&C>" );
            ch_println( ch, "&zClasses:  0 - &CFighter Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          1 - &CTransport Ship    " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          2 - &CFreighter Ship    " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          3 - &CGunboat Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          4 - &CCorvette Ship     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          5 - &CFrigate Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          6 - &CCruiser Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          7 - &CBattleship        " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          8 - &CBattlestation     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          9 - &CShip Platform     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z          10  - &CSatellite       " );
            return;
        }

        if ( atoi( argument ) < location->minshipclass )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Your maximum ship class must be more than or equal to your minimum ship class." );
            return;
        }

        location->maxshipclass = URANGE( 0, atoi( argument ), 10 );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "shipcapacity" ) )
    {
        if ( !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_GARAGE ) && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_CAN_LAND )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_CLANPAD )
                && !xIS_SET( location->flags, ROOM_HIDDEN_LAND ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You can only set ship capacity in garages or landing pads." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSet the total ship capacity that can exist in this garage/landing pad. Use 0 for unlimited." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit shipcapacity <&wvalue&C>" );
            ch_println( ch, "&zClass Sizes: 2   - &CFighter Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             5   - &CTransport Ship    " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             15  - &CFreighter Ship    " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             20  - &CGunboat Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             30  - &CCorvette Ship     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             35  - &CFrigate Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             50  - &CCruiser Ship      " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             65  - &CBattleship        " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             100 - &CBattlestation     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             200 - &CShip Platform     " );
            ch_println( ch, "&z             15  - &CSatellite       " );
            return;
        }

        if ( atoi( argument ) != 0 && atoi( argument ) < get_shipcapacity_count( location ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You cannot set the shipcapacity for this room lower than the current volume of ships here. Try moving some ships or frames out first or set it to 0 (unlimited)." );
            return;
        }

        location->shipcapacity = UMAX( 0, atoi( argument ) );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( "x", arg ) )
    {
        if ( !strstr( ch->pcdata->bestowments, "virtual" ) && get_trust( ch ) < LEVEL_PR_ADMIN )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You must be bestowed with VIRTUAL before you can set this." );
            return;
        }

        location->x = atoi( argument );
        ch_println( ch, "Changed X value to %d.", location->x );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( "y", arg ) )
    {
        if ( !strstr( ch->pcdata->bestowments, "virtual" ) && get_trust( ch ) < LEVEL_PR_ADMIN )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You must be bestowed with VIRTUAL before you can set this." );
            return;
        }

        location->y = atoi( argument );
        ch_println( ch, "Changed X value to %d.", location->y );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "xyz" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            location->mapper_coords_set = false;
            location->mapper_x = 0;
            location->mapper_y = 0;
            location->mapper_z = 0;
            ch_println( ch, "Room mapper coordinates cleared." );
            save_room( location, true );
            return;
        }

        char x_str[MIL];
        char y_str[MIL];
        char* z_str = NULL;
        argument = one_argument( argument, x_str );
        z_str = one_argument( argument, y_str );

        if ( NULLSTR( x_str ) || !is_number_sym( x_str ) ||
                NULLSTR( y_str ) || !is_number_sym( y_str ) ||
                NULLSTR( z_str ) || !is_number_sym( z_str ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit xyz <&wx&C> <&wy&C> <&wz&C>" );
            return;
        }

        location->mapper_coords_set = true;
        location->mapper_x = atoi( x_str );
        location->mapper_y = atoi( y_str );
        location->mapper_z = atoi( z_str );
        ch_println( ch, "Room mapper coordinates set." );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "ed" ) )
    {
        if ( is_busy( ch ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zCreate an extra description." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zYou must supply keyword(s)." );
            return;
        }

        CHECK_SUBRESTRICTED( ch );
        ed = SetRExtra( location, argument );

        if ( numnotdir )
        {
            if ( ( xit = get_exit_num( tmploc, edir ) ) != NULL )
                edir = xit->vdir;
        }
        else
            xit = get_exit( tmploc, edir );

        rxit = NULL;
        vnum = 0;
        rvnum[0] = '\0';

        if ( xit )
        {
            vnum = xit->vnum;

            if ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
                snprintf( rvnum, MIL, "%d", tmploc->vnum );

            if ( xit->to_room )
                rxit = get_exit( xit->to_room, rev_dir[edir] );
            else
                rxit = NULL;
        }

        snprintf( tmpcmd, SUB_MSL, "exit %s %s %s", arg2, arg3, argument );
        do_redit( ch, tmpcmd );
        save_room( ch->in_room, true );

        if ( numnotdir )
            xit = get_exit_num( tmploc, exnum );
        else
            xit = get_exit( tmploc, edir );

        if ( !rxit && xit )
        {
            vnum = xit->vnum;

            if ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
                snprintf( rvnum, MIL, "%d", tmploc->vnum );

            if ( xit->to_room )
                rxit = get_exit( xit->to_room, rev_dir[edir] );
            else
                rxit = NULL;
        }

        if ( vnum )
        {
            snprintf( tmpcmd, SUB_MSL, "%d redit exit %d %s %s",
                      vnum,
                      rev_dir[edir],
                      rvnum,
                      argument );
            do_at( ch, tmpcmd );
            save_room( get_room_index( vnum ), true );
        }

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "exdesc" ) )
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

        if ( NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zCreate or clear a description for an exit." );
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Credit exdesc <&wdir&C> [description]" );
            return;
        }

        if ( arg2[0] == '#' )
        {
            edir = atoi( arg2 + 1 );
            xit = get_exit_num( location, edir );
        }
        else
        {
            edir = get_dir( arg2 );
            xit = get_exit( location, edir );
        }

        if ( xit )
        {
            if ( !argument || argument[0] == '\0' )
                SET_STRING( xit->description, "" );
            else
            {
                snprintf( buf, MSL, "%s\n", argument );
                SET_STRING( xit->description, buf );
            }

            ch_println( ch, "Done." );
            save_room( location, true );
            return;
        }

        ch_println( ch, "No exit in that direction.  Use 'redit exit ...' first." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "vars" ) )
    {
        process_setdvar( ch, location->vars, argument, "redit vars" );
        save_room( location, true );
        return;
    }

    LUA_PARAM params[] =
    {
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_ROOM, .payload = location},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_STRING, .payload = arg},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_STRING, .payload = argument},
        { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST}
    };

    if ( lua_hook_subcmd( find_command( "redit" ), ch, origarg, params ) )
        return;

    /*
        Generate usage message.
    */
    if ( ch->substate == SUB_REPEATCMD )
    {
        ch->substate = SUB_RESTRICTED;
        interpret( ch, origarg, FALSE );
        ch->substate = SUB_REPEATCMD;
        ch->last_cmd = do_redit;
    }
    else
        do_redit( ch, "" );

    return;
}

CMDF do_ocreate( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg [MIL], arg2[MIL];
    OBJ_INDEX_DATA* pObjIndex = NULL;
    OBJ_DATA* obj = NULL;
    int vnum, cvnum;

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Mobiles cannot create." );
        return;
    }

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    if ( is_number( arg2 ) )
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );


    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) || !is_number( arg ) || NULLSTR( argument ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cocreate <&wvnum&C> [copy vnum] <&witem name&C>" );
        return;
    }

    vnum = atoi( arg );
    cvnum = is_number( arg2 ) ? atoi( arg2 ) : vnum;

    if ( vnum < 1 || vnum > ( MAX_VNUMS - 1 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Vnum not within range of possibilities." );
        return;
    }

    if ( get_obj_index( vnum ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&RAn object with that number already exists." );
        return;
    }

    if ( is_number( arg2 ) && !get_obj_index( cvnum ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&RCould not find that object to copy." );
        return;
    }

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
        return;

    AREA_DATA* pArea = area_from_vnum( vnum );

    if ( !can_build( ch, pArea ) )
        return;

    pObjIndex = make_object( vnum, cvnum, argument, TRUE );
    pObjIndex->area = pArea;

    if ( !pObjIndex )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Error." );
        log_build_string( "do_ocreate: make_object failed." );
        return;
    }

    obj = create_object( pObjIndex, get_trust( ch ) );
    obj_to_char( obj, ch );
    /* GRAL TEMP if invisible hide it */
    act( AT_IMMORT, "$n makes some ancient arcane gestures, and opens $s hands to reveal $p!", ch, obj, NULL, TO_ROOM );
    act( AT_IMMORT, "You make some ancient arcane gestures, and open your hands to reveal $p!", ch, obj, NULL, TO_CHAR );
    return;
}
