EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* SetRExtra( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room, char* keywords )
{
    EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed;

    for ( ed = room->first_extradesc; ed; ed = ed->next )
    {
        if ( is_name( keywords, ed->keyword ) )
            break;
    }

    if ( !ed )
    {
        CREATE( ed, EXTRA_DESCR_DATA, 1 );
        LINK( ed, room->first_extradesc, room->last_extradesc, next, prev );
        SET_STRING( ed->keyword, keywords );
        SET_STRING( ed->description, "" );
        top_ed++;
    }

    return ed;
}

bool DelRExtra( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room, char* keywords )
{
    EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* rmed;

    for ( rmed = room->first_extradesc; rmed; rmed = rmed->next )
    {
        if ( is_name( keywords, rmed->keyword ) )
            break;
    }

    if ( !rmed )
        return FALSE;

    UNLINK( rmed, room->first_extradesc, room->last_extradesc, next, prev );
    FREE_STRUCT_NORET( rmed, extra_desc_fields );
    top_ed--;
    return TRUE;
}

EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* SetOExtra( OBJ_DATA* obj, const char* keywords )
{
    bool name_match = FALSE;
    char token[MSL];
    int wordcounter = 0;
    EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed;
    keywords = one_argument( keywords, token );

    while ( token[0] != '\0' )
    {
        name_match = FALSE;

        for ( ed = obj->first_extradesc; ed; ed = ed->next )
        {
            if ( is_name( token, ed->keyword ) )
            {
                name_match = TRUE;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ( name_match == FALSE )
        {
            if ( wordcounter == 0 )
            {
                CREATE( ed, EXTRA_DESCR_DATA, 1 );
                LINK( ed, obj->first_extradesc, obj->last_extradesc, next, prev );
                SET_STRING( ed->keyword, token );
                SET_STRING( ed->description, "" );
                top_ed++;
            }
            else
            {
                EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed2;
                CREATE( ed2, EXTRA_DESCR_DATA, 1 );
                LINK( ed2, obj->first_extradesc, obj->last_extradesc, next, prev );
                SET_STRING( ed2->keyword, token );
                SET_STRING( ed2->description, "" );
                top_ed++;
            }
        }

        keywords = one_argument( keywords, token );
        wordcounter++;
    }

    if ( wordcounter != 1 )
    {
        ed = obj->first_extradesc;
    }

    return ed;
}

CMDF do_save_all_areas( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument __attribute__((unused)) )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL;
    int cnt = 0;

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    for ( area = first_area; area; area = area->next )
    {
        save_area( area, true, false );
        cnt++;
    }

    ch_println( ch, "&zSaved &C%d&z areas.", cnt );
    return;
}

int save_area( AREA_DATA* area, bool full, bool queue )
{
    if ( !area )
        return 0;

    if ( queue && sysdata.save_queues )
    {
        if ( full ) area->full_save = full;
        area->save_queued = TRUE;
        return E_LOTJ_SUCCESS;
    }

    area->full_save = FALSE;
    area->save_queued = FALSE;
    int result = upsert_sql_fieldmap_row("areas", area, area_fields, NO_FLAG);
    
    if (result != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS)
        return result;

    if (full)
    {
        for ( MOB_INDEX_DATA* mob = first_mob_index; mob; mob = mob->next )
            if ( mob->vnum >= area->min_vnum && mob->vnum <= area->max_vnum )
                if ((result = save_mob(mob, queue)) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS)
                    return result;

        for ( OBJ_INDEX_DATA* obj = first_obj_index; obj; obj = obj->next )
            if ( obj->vnum >= area->min_vnum && obj->vnum <= area->max_vnum )
                if ((result = save_object(obj, queue)) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS)
                    return result;

        for ( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = first_room; room; room = room->next )
            if ( room->vnum >= area->min_vnum && room->vnum <= area->max_vnum )
                if ((result = save_room(room, queue)) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS)
                    return result;
    }
    
    return E_LOTJ_SUCCESS;
}

void show_area( CHAR_DATA* ch, AREA_DATA* tarea, bool loaded )
{
    int vnum = 0, used_vnum = 0, free_vnum = 0;

    if ( !ch || !tarea )
        return;
    
    // Normal astat continues down here
    ch_println( ch, "&zName: &w%s\n&zShortname:&C %-20s\n&zStatus: %-10s &zLast enabled/disabled: &C%-s\n&zBuilders: &C%s",
               tarea->name,
               tarea->shortname,
               loaded ? ( tarea->enabled ? "&GEnabled" : "&RDisabled" ) : "&YN/A",
               loaded ? ( tarea->state_changed > 0 ? c_time( tarea->state_changed, get_timezone( ch ) ) : "Never" ) : "&YN/A",
               tarea->builders ? tarea->builders : "" );
    ch_println( ch, "&zVnums: &C%5d &w- &C%d", tarea->min_vnum, tarea->max_vnum );

    ch_println( ch, "&zMax players: &C%d  &zIllegalPks: &C%d  &zCredits Looted: &C%'d",
                tarea->max_players,
                tarea->illegal_pk,
                tarea->gold_looted );

        ch_println( ch, "&zArea economy:&Y %d billion and %'d credits.&w",
                    tarea->high_economy,
                    tarea->low_economy );
    else
        ch_println( ch, "&zArea economy: &Y%'d credits.&w",
                    tarea->low_economy );

    if ( tarea->planet )
        ch_println( ch, "&zPlanet: &C%s.",
                    tarea->planet->name );

    if ( tarea->clan )
        ch_println( ch, "&zClan: &C%s.",
                    tarea->clan->name );

    ch_println( ch, "&zMdeaths: &W%d  &zMkills: &W%d  &zPdeaths: &R%d  &zPkills: &R%d",
                tarea->mdeaths,
                tarea->mkills,
                tarea->pdeaths,
                tarea->pkills );

    ch_println( ch, "&zAuthor: &C%s\n&zAmbience: &C%d\n&zAge: &c%d   &zNumber of players: &C%d",
               tarea->author,
               tarea->ambience,
               tarea->age,

               : "&w(default)" ); /* Rennard */
    ch_println( ch, "&zReset frequency&z: &C%d minutes.&w",
               tarea->reset_frequency ? tarea->reset_frequency : 15 );

    if ( loaded && tarea->enabled )
    {
        for ( vnum = tarea->min_vnum ; vnum <= tarea->max_vnum ; vnum++ )
        {
            if ( get_room_index( vnum ) == NULL )
                free_vnum++;
            else
                used_vnum++;

        ch_println( ch, "&zAvailable Rooms: %s%d &wfilled, %s%d &wunfilled.",
        used_vnum > ( used_vnum / 2 ) ? "&R" : used_vnum > ( used_vnum / 3 ) ? "&Y" : "&c", used_vnum,
        free_vnum < ( free_vnum * 2 ) ? "&R" : free_vnum < ( used_vnum * 3 ) ? "&Y" : "&c", free_vnum );

        for ( vnum = tarea->min_vnum ; vnum <= tarea->max_vnum ; vnum++ )

                free_vnum++;
            else
                used_vnum++;

        used_vnum > ( used_vnum / 2 ) ? "&R" : used_vnum > ( used_vnum / 3 ) ? "&Y" : "&c", used_vnum,
        free_vnum < ( free_vnum * 2 ) ? "&R" : free_vnum < ( used_vnum * 3 ) ? "&Y" : "&c", free_vnum );

        for ( vnum = tarea->min_vnum ; vnum <= tarea->max_vnum ; vnum++ )

                free_vnum++;
            else
                used_vnum++;

        ch_println( ch, "&zAvailable Objects: %s%d &wfilled, %s%d &wunfilled.",
        used_vnum > ( used_vnum / 2 ) ? "&R" : used_vnum > ( used_vnum / 3 ) ? "&Y" : "&c", used_vnum,

    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zHail Locations:" );

        for ( HAIL_DATA* pHail = tarea->first_hail; pHail; pHail = pHail->next )
            ch_println( ch, "&z[&C%s&z]&w to Room: &C%d", pHail->name, pHail->vnum );
    }
    
    if ( !NULLSTR( tarea->notes ) )
        ch_println( ch, "&zNotes:\n&w%s", tarea->notes );

    return;
}

CMDF do_astat( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AREA_DATA* tarea = NULL;
    char arg[MIL];
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) && ch->in_room )
        tarea = ch->in_room->area;

    if ( !tarea && !NULLSTR( arg ) )
        tarea = get_area( arg );
    
    if ( !tarea && !NULLSTR( arg ) )
        tarea = get_archived_area( arg );

    if ( !tarea )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&RArea not found.  Check 'zones'." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_prefix( "flag", argument ) ) // Handle flag searches/reviews
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg ); // Ditch area keyword

        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Which flag would you like to check for?" );
            return;
        }
        else
        {
            int cnt = 0;
            int flg = get_flag( argument, room_flags );
            if ( flg == FLAG_UNDEFINED )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Unknown room flag." );
                return;
            }

            ROOM_INDEX_DATA* troom;
            for ( int i = tarea->min_vnum; i <= tarea->max_vnum; i++ )
            {
                if ( !( troom = get_room_index( i ) ) )
                    continue;

                if ( !xIS_SET( troom->flags, flg ) )
                    continue;

                cnt++;
                ch_printf( ch, "&zRoom &w#&z: &C%-10d  &wFlag: &C%s\n", i, room_flags[flg].name );
            }

            if ( cnt )
                ch_println( ch, "&zFound a total of &C%d room%s&z with that flag.&w", cnt, cnt == 1 ? "" : "s" );
            else
                ch_println( ch, "&wCould not find any rooms with the flag %s.&w", room_flags[flg].name );

            return;
        }
    }

    show_area( ch, tarea, true );
    ch_println( ch, "\n&zSyntax: &Castat <&wshortname&C>&w" );
    ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Castat <&wshortname&C> flags <&wflag to search&C>&w" );
}
char* print_wanted( CHAR_DATA* ch, bool print_immune )
{
    static char buf[MSL];
    DB_DATA* wnted = NULL;
    buf[0] = '\0';

    if ( ch && ch->pcdata )
    {
        for ( wnted = first_wanted; wnted; wnted = wnted->next )
        {
            if ( !wnted )
                continue;

            if ( str_cmp( wnted->name, ch->name ) )
                continue;

            if ( wnted->num1 != TRUE && print_immune == FALSE )
                continue;

            if ( wnted->num2 != print_immune )
                continue;

            strlcat( buf, wnted->str1, MSL );
            strlcat( buf, " ", MSL );

            if ( !NULLSTR( wnted->str2 ) )
            {
                strlcat( buf, "(", MSL );
                strlcat( buf, wnted->str2, MSL );
                strlcat( buf, ") ", MSL );
            }
        }
    }

    return buf;
}

{

bool is_wanted_on( CHAR_DATA* ch, PLANET_DATA* planet )
{
    DB_DATA* wnted = NULL;

    if ( !ch || !planet || !ch->pcdata )
        return FALSE;

    wnted = get_wanted_char( ch->name, planet->name );

    if ( !wnted )
        return FALSE;

    if ( wnted->num2 == TRUE )
        return FALSE;

    return wnted->num1;
}

// wanted value can be 0 (false), 1 (true), 2 (grant immunity) or 3 (remove immunity)
// for setting immunity or removing wanted status, crime_type is ignored and can be 0.
DB_DATA* set_wanted( const char* chname, const char* plname, int wanted, int crime_type )
{
    PLANET_DATA* planet = NULL;
    DB_DATA* wnted = NULL;
    const FLAG_INFO* crime = NULL;
    char buf[MIL];
    planet = get_planet( plname );

    if ( !chname || chname[0] == '\0' || !plname || plname[0] == '\0' )
        return NULL;

    if ( planet )
    {
        if ( xIS_SET( planet->flags, PLANET_STAR ) )
        {
            return NULL;
        }

        wnted = get_wanted_char( chname, plname );

        if ( wnted == NULL )
        {
            CREATE( wnted, DB_DATA, 1 );
            SET_STRING( wnted->name, capitalize( chname ) );
            SET_STRING( wnted->str1, plname );
            SET_STRING( wnted->str2, "" );
            wnted->id = 0;
            LINK( wnted, first_wanted, last_wanted, next, prev );
           
        }

        if ( wanted <= 1 )
        {
            wnted->num1 = wanted;

            // If they're being set as wanted for doing something specific, add it to the str2
            if ( wanted && crime_type != FLAG_UNDEFINED && ( crime = flag_from_num( crime_flags, crime_type ) ) != NULL )
            {
                strlcpy( buf, wnted->str2, MIL );

                if ( !strstr( wnted->str2, crime->desc ) )
                {
                    if ( !NULLSTR( buf ) )
                        strlcat( buf, ", ", MIL );

                    strlcat( buf, crime->desc, MIL );
                    SET_STRING( wnted->str2, buf );
                }
            }
        }

        if ( wanted == 3 )
        {
            wnted->num2 = FALSE;
        }
        else if ( wanted == 2 || wnted->num2 == TRUE ) //immunity
        {
            wnted->num1 = FALSE;
            wnted->num2 = TRUE;
        }

        // Be sure we clear their crime list when removing wanted status
        if ( wnted->num1 == FALSE && !NULLSTR( wnted->str2 ) )
            SET_STRING( wnted->str2, "" );
        save_dbase_sql(DB_TABLE_WANTED,wnted);
        //save_wanted();
        return wnted;
    }
    else
    {
        return NULL;
    }
}

DB_DATA* get_wanted_char( const char* chname, const char* plname )
{
    DB_DATA* wnted = NULL;

    if ( !chname || chname[0] == '\0' || !plname || plname[0] == '\0' )
        return NULL;

    for ( wnted = first_wanted; wnted; wnted = wnted->next )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( wnted->str1, plname ) && !str_cmp( wnted->name, capitalize( chname ) ) )
            return wnted;
    }

    return NULL;
}
void clear_wanted( const char* name )
{
    DB_DATA* db = NULL, *dbnext = NULL;

    for ( db = first_wanted; db; db = dbnext )
    {
        dbnext = db->next;

        if ( str_cmp( db->name, name ) )
            continue;

        delete_dbase_sql( DB_TABLE_WANTED, db );
        UNLINK( db, first_wanted, last_wanted, next, prev );
        extract_db( db );
    }  
}

CMDF do_wanted( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL], colstr[8];
    int cnt = 0;
    PLANET_DATA* planet = NULL;
    DB_DATA* wanted = NULL, *next_wanted = NULL;
    bool arg_all = FALSE;

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) || NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cwanted list <&wplanet/all&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Cwanted clear <&wplanet/character/all&C>" );
        return;
    }

    arg_all = !str_cmp( arg2, "all" );

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "list" ) )
    {
        if ( !arg_all )
        {
            planet = get_planet( arg2 );
            if ( !planet )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "&zPlanet &C%s&z not found.", arg2 );
                return;
            }
        }

        if ( !first_wanted )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "There are no wanted entries." );
            return;
        }

        // Declare the array of pointers to copy the linked list into
        DB_DATA** wanteds = NULL;

        // Use a macro to copy the linked list (first_wanted to last_wanted) into an array of pointers
        LINK_TO_ARRAY( first_wanted, DB_DATA, next, wanteds );

        // Sort first by character name (secondary) and then by planet name (prmary)
        SORT_ARRAY( wanteds, DB_DATA, alphabetize, name );
        SORT_ARRAY( wanteds, DB_DATA, alphabetize, str1 );

        pager_println( ch, "&z%-16s | %-12s | %-26s | %-17s", "NAME", "PLANET", "CRIME", "CREATED" );

        for ( int i = 0; wanteds[i]; i++ )
        {
            if ( planet && str_cmp( wanteds[i]->str1, planet->name ) )
                continue;
            
            cnt++;
            snprintf( colstr, 8, "%s", cnt % 2 == 0 ? "&037" : "&116" );
            
            pager_println( ch, "%s%-16s &z| %s%-12s &z| %s%-26s &z| %s%-17s",
                colstr, wanteds[i]->name,
                colstr, wanteds[i]->str1,
                colstr, wanteds[i]->str2,
                colstr, mini_c_time( wanteds[i]->created_at, get_timezone( ch ), FALSE ) );
        }

        pager_println( ch, "\n&zDisplayed &C%'d&z wanted entries.", cnt );
        if ( wanteds ) free( wanteds );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg, "clear" ) )
    {
        if ( !arg_all )
            planet = get_planet( arg2 );
        
        for ( wanted = first_wanted; wanted; wanted = next_wanted )
        {
            next_wanted = wanted->next;
            if ( !arg_all && planet && str_cmp( wanted->str1, planet->name ) )
                continue;
            
            if ( !arg_all && !planet && str_cmp( wanted->name, arg2 ) )
                continue;
            
            UNLINK( wanted, first_wanted, last_wanted, next, prev );
            delete_dbase_sql( DB_TABLE_WANTED, wanted );
            extract_db( wanted );
            cnt++;
        }

        ch_println( ch, "&zCleared &C%'d&z wanted entries.", cnt );
        return;
    }

    do_wanted( ch, "" );
    return;
}

/**
 * @brief Copies an area.
 * @author Nield
 * @date 2025-07-15
 * 
 * This allows us to copy an area within the same MUD environment
 * (as opposed to migratearea, which moves areas between environments).
 * This will optionally let us specify a new starting VNum/VNum range
 * for the new area.
 * 
 * @param ch The character invoking the function.
 * @param argument The user input provided after the command name.
 */
CMDF do_acopy( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL, *tarea = NULL;
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL], arg3[MIL], buf[1024];
    int newstart = 0, offset = 0, rval = 0;
    int objs = 0, rooms = 0, mobs = 0;

    // Let's tee this message up early, just in case...
    snprintf( buf, 1024, "\n *** [ALERT] EMERGENCY COPYOVER, PLEASE STAND BY...\n" );

    // This is a hard-coded restriction to prevent non-imms from running this.
    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) || NULLSTR( arg2 ) || ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) && !is_number( arg3 ) ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cacopy <&warea shortname&C> <&wnew shortname&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Cacopy <&warea shortname&C> <&wnew shortname&C> [new starting vnum]" );
        return;
    }

    // First, start by getting the area to be copied.
    area = get_area( arg );
    if ( !area ) area = get_archived_area( arg );
    if ( !area )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zArea &C%s&z not found.", arg );
        return;
    }

    // Now make sure that the shortname for the new area isn't already in use.
    tarea = get_area( arg2 );
    if ( !tarea ) get_archived_area( arg2 );
    if ( tarea )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zArea &C%s&z already exists.", arg2 );
        return;
    }

    // If the third argument was provided, figure out what that VNum is.
    if ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
        newstart = atoi( arg3 );

    // If that VNum is out of range, it's verboten.
    if ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) && ( newstart <= 0 || newstart > MAX_VNUMS ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zInvalid starting vnum &C%d&z for new area.", newstart );
        return;
    }

    // Start a critical period to force a copyover if things get squirrely.
    critical_start();

    /* We're using an SQL transaction for this process to make this an all-or-nothing affair. If any
       of the downstream functions return an error, we'll roll the transaction back and copyover to
       return us to the status quo. */
    if ( ( rval = begin_sql_transaction() ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to begin transaction when copying area: %s", FUNC, lotj_strerror(rval) );
        return;
    }

    // Start by duplicating the area struct.
    tarea = duplicate_area( area, arg2 );
    
    // We really shouldn't fail out at this step -- but if we do, bail out.
    if ( !tarea )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to load/duplicate area %s", FUNC, area->shortname );
        ch_println( ch, "&RArea duplication failed." );

        if ( ( rval = rollback_sql_transaction() ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
        {
            bug( "%s: failed to roll back transaction after failure to copy area: %s", FUNC, lotj_strerror(rval) );
            copyover( buf, true, true, true );
        }
        return;
    }

    // When copying an area, it always starts life as disabled. It can be enabled using "aset" afterwards.
    tarea->enabled = FALSE;

    /* If we've got a new VNum range for the new area, offset the new area's hailpoints accordingly. */
    if ( newstart > 0 )
    {
        offset = newstart - tarea->min_vnum;
        tarea->min_vnum += offset;
        tarea->max_vnum += offset;
        offset_area_hailpoints( &tarea->first_hail, area->min_vnum, area->max_vnum, offset );
    }

    /* This is where the magic happens. We duplicate the object indices, mob indices, and rooms -- in that order.
       If any of these duplication functions fail, we abort the area copy process, roll back the transaction, and
       copyover. */
    if ( duplicate_objects( area, tarea, MAIN_DB, offset, &objs ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS || duplicate_mobs( area, tarea, MAIN_DB, offset, &mobs ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS || duplicate_rooms( area, tarea, MAIN_DB, offset, &rooms ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to duplicate area. Rolling back.", FUNC );
        rollback_sql_transaction();
        copyover( buf, true, true, true );
        return;
    }

    // Link the area into the linked list for disabled areas.
    LINK_SORT_NAME( tarea, AREA_DATA, first_area_archive, last_area_archive, next, prev, shortname );

    // Save the new area struct itself to the database.
    save_area( tarea, false, false );

    /* We're in the home stretch! If we've made it this far, commit the transaction. If this fails,
       we may have a database issue -- but all we can really do is copyover and hope for the best. */
    if ( ( rval = commit_sql_transaction() ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to commit transaction when copying area: %s", FUNC, lotj_strerror(rval) );
        copyover( buf, true, true, true );
        return;
    }

    // Success! Let the user know what was copied.
    ch_println( ch, "&zCopied area &C%s&z into &C%s&z.", area->shortname, tarea->shortname );
    ch_println( ch, "&zCopied &C%d&z objects.", objs );
    ch_println( ch, "&zCopied &C%d&z rooms.", rooms );
    ch_println( ch, "&zCopied &C%d&z mobs.", mobs );
    ch_println( ch, "&zCopy successful. Use &Caset %s enable&z to enable the area.", tarea->shortname );
    
    // End the critical period.
    critical_end();

    // Mission accomplished.
    return;
}

bool is_available_vnum_block( int min, int qty, bool strict )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL;
    int max = 0;

    if ( qty <= 0 )
        return false;

    max = min + qty - 1;

    if ( max > MAX_VNUMS )
        return FALSE;

    for ( area = first_area; area; area = area->next )
        if ( area->max_vnum >= min && area->min_vnum <= max )
            return FALSE;

    if ( strict )
        for ( area = first_area_archive; area; area = area->next )
            if ( area->max_vnum >= min && area->min_vnum <= max )
                return FALSE;
    
    // If we didn't find any conflicts, we're good
    return TRUE;
}

CMDF do_checkvnumblock( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL], arg3[MIL];
    bool strict = false;
    int min = 0, qty = 0;
    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) || !is_number( arg ) || NULLSTR( arg2 ) || !is_number( arg2 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Ccheckvnumblock <&wstarting vnum&C> <&wqty&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Ccheckvnumblock <&wstarting vnum&C> <&wqty&C> strict" );
        return;
    }

    strict = ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) && !str_cmp( arg3, "strict" ) );
    min = atoi( arg );
    qty = atoi( arg2 );

    if ( min <= 0 )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Invalid starting vnum. Value must be greater than 0." );
        return;
    }

    if ( qty <= 0 )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Invalid quantity of vnums. Value must be greater than 0." );
        return;
    }

    ch_println( ch, "&wThere %s&w %d vnums available starting with %d.", is_available_vnum_block( min, qty, strict ) ? "&Gare" : "&RARE NOT", qty, min );
    return;
}

int get_available_vnum( int qty, bool strict )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL, *narea = NULL, *tarea = NULL;
    bool conflict = false;
    int min = 0, max = 0;

    if ( qty <= 0 )
        return -1;

    for ( area = first_area; area; area = area->next )
    {
        narea = area->next;
        conflict = false;
        min = area->max_vnum + 1;
        max = min + qty - 1;
        
        if ( narea && ( narea->min_vnum - min ) < qty )
            continue;
        
        if ( !narea && ( MAX_VNUMS - min ) < qty )
            continue;
        
        if ( strict )
        {
            for ( tarea = first_area_archive; tarea; tarea = tarea->next )
            {
                if ( tarea->max_vnum >= min && tarea->min_vnum <= max )
                {
                    conflict = TRUE;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        // If we got all the way through to the end and didn't find any conflict, return the available starting vnum
        if ( !conflict )
            return min;
    }
    
    // If we didn't find any block large enough, return -1
    return -1;
}

CMDF do_vnumquery( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL];
    int qty = 0, result = 0;
    bool strict = FALSE;

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) || !is_number( arg ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cvnumquery <&wnumber of vnums&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cvnumquery <&wnumber of vnums&C> strict" );
        ch_println( ch, "\n&zNote: Strict will ensure no conflicts even among disabled areas." );
        return;
    }

    qty = atoi( arg );
    
    if ( qty <= 0 )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Invalid number of vnums specified. Value must be greater than 0." );
        return;
    }

    strict = ( !NULLSTR( arg2 ) && !str_cmp( arg2, "strict" ) );
    result = get_available_vnum( qty, strict );
    
    if ( result == -1 )
        ch_println( ch, "&RNo available vnum ranges found for %d vnums%s.", qty, strict ? " and no conflicts" : "" );
    else
        ch_println( ch, "&zThe first available vnum block for &C%d&z vnums is &C%d&z - &C%d&z", qty, result, ( result + qty - 1 ) );

    return;
}

CMDF do_acreate( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL;
    char arg1[MIL], arg2[MIL], arg3[MIL];
    int qty = 0, new_min = 0, new_max = 0;

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) || NULLSTR( arg2 ) || !is_number( arg2 ) || ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) && !is_number( arg3 ) ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Cacreate <&wshortname&C> <&wnumber of vnums&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cacreate <&wshortname&C> <&wmin vnum&C> <&wmax vnum&C>" );
        return;
    }

    if ( NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
    {
        qty = atoi( arg2 );
        new_min = get_available_vnum( qty, true );

        if ( new_min == -1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&RUnable to find an available vnum block for %d vnums.", qty );
            return;
        }

        new_max = new_min + qty - 1;
    }
    else
    {
        new_min = atoi( arg2 );
        new_max = atoi( arg3 );
    }

    if ( new_min > new_max )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Maximum vnum must be greater than minimum vnum." );
        return;
    }

    // Check for other areas which overlap with the new range
    for ( area = first_area; area; area = area->next )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( area->shortname, arg1 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "An active area with that shortname already exists." );
            return;
        }

        if ( new_max >= area->min_vnum && new_min <= area->max_vnum )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That vnum range conflicts with existing area %s (%d - %d)", area->shortname, area->min_vnum, area->max_vnum );
            return;
        }
    }

    for ( area = first_area_archive; area; area = area->next )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( area->shortname, arg1 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "An archived area with that shortname already exists." );
            return;
        }
    }

    area = NULL;
    CREATE( area, AREA_DATA, 1 );
    SET_STRING( area->shortname, arg1 );
    SET_STRING( area->name, arg1 );
    SET_STRING( area->author, ch->name );
    SET_STRING( area->builders, ch->name );
    SET_STRING( area->notes, "" );
    area->enabled = TRUE;
    area->min_vnum = new_min;
    area->max_vnum = new_max;
    area->version = AREA_VERSION;
    LINK_SORT_NUM( area, AREA_DATA, first_area, last_area, next, prev, min_vnum );
    int rval = save_area( area, false, false );

    if ( rval != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Area creation failed: %s", lotj_strerror( rval ) );
        UNLINK( area, first_area, last_area, next, prev );
        return;
    }

    ch_println( ch, "&zArea &C%s&z created with vnum range &C%d&z - &C%d&z.", area->shortname, area->min_vnum, area->max_vnum );
    return;
}

int delete_area( AREA_DATA* tarea )
{
    char buf[MSL];

    if ( !tarea )
        return E_LOTJ_MISSING_ARGUMENTS;

    if ( tarea->enabled )
    {
        unload_mobs( tarea, TRUE );
        unload_objects( tarea, TRUE );
        unload_rooms( tarea );
        UNLINK( tarea, first_area, last_area, next, prev );
    }
    else
        UNLINK( tarea, first_area_archive, last_area_archive, next, prev );

    for ( PLANET_DATA* planet = first_planet; planet; planet = planet->next )
    {
        AREA_DATA_LNODE* lArea = NULL, *lArea_next = NULL;
        for ( lArea = planet->first_area; lArea; lArea = lArea_next )
        {
            lArea_next = lArea->next;
            if ( lArea->value == tarea )
            {
                UNLINK( lArea, planet->first_area, planet->last_area, next, prev );
                FREE_STRUCT_NORET( lArea, area_lnode_fields ); 
            }
        }
    }

    snprintf( buf, MSL, "vnum BETWEEN %d AND %d AND area = %s", tarea->min_vnum, tarea->max_vnum, sql_escape_string( tarea->shortname ) );
    delete_sql_by_where( DB_TABLE_MOBS, buf );
    delete_sql_by_where( DB_TABLE_OBJECTS, buf );
    delete_sql_by_where( DB_TABLE_ROOMS, buf );
    snprintf( buf, MSL, "shortname = %s", sql_escape_string( tarea->shortname ) );
    delete_sql_by_where( DB_TABLE_AREAS, buf );
    free_area( tarea );
    fix_exits();
    return E_LOTJ_SUCCESS;
}

CMDF do_adelete( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AREA_DATA* tarea = NULL;
    char arg[MIL];

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cadelete <&warea shortname&C>" );
        return;
    }

    tarea = get_area( arg );
    
    if ( !tarea )
        tarea = get_archived_area( arg );

    if ( !tarea )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Area %s not found.", arg );
        return;
    }

    if ( get_trust( ch ) < LEVEL_SUPREME )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You must be at least level %d to delete areas.", LEVEL_SUPREME );
        return;
    }

    ch_println( ch, "&RDeleting %s...", tarea->shortname );
    delete_area( tarea );
    ch_println( ch, "&RDone." );
    return;
}

/**
 * @brief Applies VNum offsets to game data
 * @author Nield
 * @date 2025-07-17
 * 
 * This allows us to apply VNum offsets to active game data while
 * the game is live.
 * 
 * @param oldmin The low VNum within the range of VNums to be offset.
 * @param oldmax The high VNum within the range of VNums to be offset.
 * @param offset The number of VNums (+/-) to shift impacted VNums towards.
 */
int offset_vnums( int oldmin, int oldmax, int offset )
{
    LUA_LOOM* loom = NULL, *next_loom = NULL;
    LUA_PROGRAM_LNODE* first_included = NULL, UNUSED(*last_included) = NULL, *prog_node = NULL, *next_node = NULL;
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = NULL;
    MOB_INDEX_DATA* mob = NULL;
    OBJ_INDEX_DATA* obj = NULL;
    MPROG_DATA* mprog = NULL;
    SHIP_TEMPLATE_DATA* ship = NULL;
    PLANET_DATA* planet = NULL;
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL;
    char loom_id[MIL];
    const char* reason;

    lotj_ready = FALSE;
    for ( room = first_room; room; room = room->next )
    {
        if ( offset_turbolift_floors( room->lift, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
            save_room( room, TRUE );

        if ( offset_room_exits( &room->first_exit, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
            save_room( room, TRUE );

        if ( offset_reset_vnums( &room->first_reset, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
            save_room( room, TRUE );

        for ( mprog = room->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( mprog->arglist && offset_prog_vnums( &mprog->arglist, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
                save_room( room, TRUE );

            if ( mprog->comlist && offset_prog_vnums( &mprog->comlist, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
                save_room( room, TRUE );                        
        }

        if ( room->lprog_code && offset_prog_vnums( &room->lprog_code, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
        {
            save_room( room, TRUE );
            reload_lua_program( room_lprog_identifier( room ), &reason );
        }
    }

    for ( mob = first_mob_index; mob; mob = mob->next )
    {
        for ( mprog = mob->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( mprog->arglist && offset_prog_vnums( &mprog->arglist, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
                save_mob( mob, TRUE );

            if ( mprog->comlist && offset_prog_vnums( &mprog->comlist, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
                save_mob( mob, TRUE );                        
        }

        if ( mob->lprog_code && offset_prog_vnums( &mob->lprog_code, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
        {
            save_mob( mob, TRUE );
            reload_lua_program( ch_proto_lprog_identifier( mob ), &reason );
        }
    }

    for ( obj = first_obj_index; obj; obj = obj->next )
    {
        for ( mprog = obj->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( mprog->arglist && offset_prog_vnums( &mprog->arglist, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
                save_object( obj, TRUE );

            if ( mprog->comlist && offset_prog_vnums( &mprog->comlist, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
                save_object( obj, TRUE );                        
        }

        if ( obj->lprog_code && offset_prog_vnums( &obj->lprog_code, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
        {
            save_object( obj, TRUE );
            reload_lua_program( obj_proto_lprog_identifier( obj ), &reason );
        }
    }

    for ( ship = first_shipimage; ship; ship = ship->next )
    {
        if ( ship->lprog_code && offset_prog_vnums( &ship->lprog_code, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
        {
            save_ship_template( ship, TRUE );
            reload_lua_program( ship_lprog_identifier( ship ), &reason );
        }
    }

    for ( loom = first_loom; loom; loom = next_loom )
    {
        next_loom = loom->next;
        if ( loom->enabled && loom->code && offset_prog_vnums( &loom->code, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
        {
            snprintf( loom_id, MIL, "%s", loom->filename );
            
            first_included = loom->first_included;
            last_included = loom->last_included;
            loom->first_included = NULL;
            loom->last_included = NULL;
            fwrite_loom( loom );
            dispose_loom( loom );
            fread_loom( loom_id, true );
            // reload all of the programs that include this loom using the reload_lua_program function
            for ( prog_node = first_included; prog_node; prog_node = next_node )
            {
                next_node = prog_node->next;
                UNLINK( prog_node, first_included, last_included, next, prev );
                if ( prog_node->value && prog_node->value->identifier )
                    reload_lua_program( prog_node->value->identifier, NULL );
                DISPOSE( prog_node );
            }
        }
    }

    // Make sure to apply offsets to the planetary mob resets.
    for ( planet = first_planet; planet; planet = planet->next )
        if ( offset_planet_vnums( planet, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
            save_planet( planet, TRUE );

    // Remember to offset the area hailpoints as well.
    for ( area = first_area; area; area = area->next )           
        if ( offset_area_hailpoints( &area->first_hail, oldmin, oldmax, offset ) > 0 )
            save_area( area, FALSE, TRUE );

    lotj_ready = TRUE;
    return E_LOTJ_SUCCESS;
}

/**
 * @brief Moves an area to a new VNum range.
 * @author Nield
 * @date 2025-07-15
 * 
 * This allows us to move an existing area to a new VNum range.
 * 
 * @param ch The character invoking the function.
 * @param argument The user input provided after the command name.
 */
CMDF do_movearea( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL, *tarea = NULL;
    REMAP_DATA* remap = NULL;
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL], query[MSL], oldname[MIL], tempname[MIL], buf[1024];
    int newstart = 0, asize = 0, rval = 0, offset = 0, oldmin = 0, oldmax = 0;
    int objs = 0, rooms = 0, mobs = 0;

    // This is an imm-only command.
    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    // Let's tee this error message up early, just in case...
    snprintf( buf, 1024, "\n *** [ALERT] EMERGENCY COPYOVER, PLEASE STAND BY...\n" );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) || NULLSTR( arg2 ) || !is_number( arg2 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cmovearea <&warea shortname&C> <&wnew starting vnum&C>" );
        return;
    }

    // Make sure the area exists.
    area = get_area( arg );

    if ( !area )
        area = get_archived_area( arg );
    
    if ( !area )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zArea &C%s&z not found.", arg );
        return;
    }
    
    // Make sure the new VNum value is within range.
    newstart = atoi( arg2 );

    if ( newstart <= 0 )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zNew starting vnum must be greater than zero." );
        return;
    }

    // If the area is enabled and there is another enabled area with conflicting VNums, we can't proceed. 
    asize = area->max_vnum - area->min_vnum + 1;
    if ( area->enabled && !is_available_vnum_block( newstart, asize, false ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&RThere aren't %d vnums available starting with %d", asize, newstart );
        return;
    }

    // Start a critical period to force a copyover if anything gets squirrely.
    critical_start();

    /* Here's a bit of hackery to facilitate what basically amounts to creating a new duplicate of
       the old area with the new VNum range, deleting the old area, and saving the new area as though
       it were the old area. */
    snprintf( oldname, MIL, "%s", area->shortname );
    snprintf( tempname, MIL, "tmparea_%d.are", number_range( 1000, 9999 ) );
    
    /* We're doing this using an SQL transaction to make it an all-or-nothing process. If any of the
       downstream functions report an error, we'll roll back the transaction and copyover to return us
       to the status quo. Nothing saves unless everything succeeds. */
    if ( (rval = begin_sql_transaction()) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to begin transaction when updating area vnums: %s", FUNC, lotj_strerror(rval) );
        critical_end();
        return;
    }

    // Start by creating a new area.
    tarea = duplicate_area( area, tempname );

    // We really shouldn't fail out here. Bail out if we do. 
    if ( !tarea )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to duplicate area for relocation.", FUNC );
        ch_println( ch, "&RFailed to move the area." );

        if ( ( rval = rollback_sql_transaction() ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
        {
            bug( "%s: failed to roll back transaction after failure to update area vnums: %s", FUNC, lotj_strerror(rval) );
            copyover( buf, true, true, true );
        }

        critical_end();
        return;
    }

    // Store the old VNum range.
    oldmin = tarea->min_vnum;
    oldmax = tarea->max_vnum;

    // If the area is enabled, this will let us hot-swap the objects, mobs, and rooms that are currently loaded into memory.
    tarea->enabled = area->enabled;

    // Figure out the offset values and apply them to the new area.
    offset = newstart - tarea->min_vnum;
    tarea->min_vnum += offset;
    tarea->max_vnum += offset;

    // Create a record of the remapping for loading in objects and such
    CREATE( remap, REMAP_DATA, 1 );
    remap->area_id = area->id;
    remap->min_vnum = oldmin;
    remap->max_vnum = oldmax;
    remap->offset = offset;
    remap->date = current_time;
    LINK( remap, tarea->first_remap, tarea->last_remap, next, prev );
    
    // Save the new area to the database.
    save_area( tarea, false, false );

    /* This is where the magic happens. We duplicate the object indices, mob indices, and rooms -- in that order.
       If any of these duplication functions fail, we abort the area move process, roll back the transaction, and
       copyover. Most of the hotswapping logic exists in these three duplicate_ functions we're calling below. */
    if ( duplicate_objects( area, tarea, MAIN_DB, offset, &objs ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS || duplicate_mobs( area, tarea, MAIN_DB, offset, &mobs ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS || duplicate_rooms( area, tarea, MAIN_DB, offset, &rooms ) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to duplicate area for relocation. Rolling back.", FUNC );
        rollback_sql_transaction();
        copyover( buf, true, true, true );
        return;
    }

    // Update the area mappings for planets.
    tarea->planet = area->planet;
    for ( PLANET_DATA* planet = first_planet; planet; planet = planet->next )
    {
        for ( AREA_DATA_LNODE* aNode = planet->first_area; aNode; aNode = aNode->next )
        {
            if ( aNode->value == area )
            {
                aNode->value = tarea;
                save_planet( planet, true );
            }
        }
    }

    // Sweep through every room and area and offset the vnums, if applicable
    if ( offset != 0 )
        offset_vnums( oldmin, oldmax, offset );

    // Delete the original area completely.
    delete_area( area );

    /* Since the new area and its rooms/object indices/mob indices were saved under that temporary shortname, update the DB rows via custom queries. This
       is the only practical way to do this; the alternative would be to load all these things into MUD memory, delete them from the DB, update the
       shortnames of the structs, and re-save them individually. Let's not do that. */ 
    snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET shortname=%s WHERE shortname=%s", DB_TABLE_AREAS, sql_escape_string(oldname), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
    query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );
    snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET area=%s WHERE area=%s", DB_TABLE_ROOMS, sql_escape_string(oldname), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
    query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );
    snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET area=%s WHERE area=%s", DB_TABLE_MOBS, sql_escape_string(oldname), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
    query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );
    snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET area=%s WHERE area=%s", DB_TABLE_OBJECTS, sql_escape_string(oldname), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
    query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );

    // We can now safely update the new area struct's shortname.
    SET_STRING( tarea->shortname, oldname );

    // Always fix the exits. Very important.
    fix_exits();

    // If the area should be enabled, let's link it up.
    if ( tarea->enabled )
    {
        LINK_SORT_NUM( tarea, AREA_DATA, first_area, last_area, next, prev, min_vnum );
        top_area++;


        // Run the resets to load in any mobs, objects, non-player vendors, etc.
        reset_area( tarea );    
    }
    else
        LINK_SORT_NAME( tarea, AREA_DATA, first_area_archive, last_area_archive, next, prev, shortname );
    
    // Save the area itself once more, just to capture the last few changes. 
    save_area( tarea, false, false );

    /* We're in the home stretch! If we'v made it this far, commit the saves to the database. If this fails,
    we may have a database problem -- but all we can really do is copyover and hope for the best. */
    if ( (rval = commit_sql_transaction()) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
    {
        bug( "%s: failed to commit transaction when updating area vnums: %s", FUNC, lotj_strerror(rval) );
        copyover(buf, true, true, true);
        return;
    }

    ch_println( ch, "Done!" );

    // End the critical period.
    critical_end();

    // Mission accomplished.
    return;
}

CMDF do_aset( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AREA_DATA* tarea = NULL;
    BUFFER_DATA* buffer = NULL;
    char arg1[MIL], arg2[MIL], arg3[MIL], arg4[MIL];
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    switch ( ch->substate )
    {
        default:
            break;

        case SUB_RESTRICTED:
            ch_println( ch, "You can't use this command from within another command." );
            return;

        case SUB_EDIT_AREA:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            if ( !buffer || ( tarea = (AREA_DATA*) buffer->buf1 ) == NULL )
            {
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }
            
            dispose_buffer( buffer );
            SET_STRING( tarea->notes, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            save_area( tarea, false, true );
            return;
    }

    if ( arg1[0] == '\0' || arg2[0] == '\0' )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> <&wfield&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Caset <&wshortname&C> <&wenable&C/&wdisable&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "\n&zField being one of:&w" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  name shortname vnums" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  planet clan hail low_economy high_economy author" );
        ch_println( ch, "&B  resetmsg resetfreq ambience flags builders notes" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "enable" ) )
        tarea = get_archived_area( arg1 );
    else
        tarea = get_area( arg1 );

    if ( !tarea )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "%s not found.", str_cmp( arg2, "enable" ) ? "Area" : "Archived area" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "enable" ) )
    {
        if ( tarea->enabled )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&R%s has an inconsistent load state and cannot be enabled." );
            return;
        }

        // Check for other areas which overlap with the new range
        for ( AREA_DATA* pArea = first_area; pArea; pArea = pArea->next )
        {
            if ( tarea->max_vnum >= pArea->min_vnum && tarea->min_vnum <= pArea->max_vnum )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "That area's vnum range conflicts with another loaded area: %s (%d - %d)", pArea->shortname, pArea->min_vnum, pArea->max_vnum );
                return;
            }
        }

        tarea->enabled = TRUE;
        tarea->state_changed = time( 0 );
        UNLINK( tarea, first_area_archive, last_area_archive, next, prev );
        LINK_SORT_NUM( tarea, AREA_DATA, first_area, last_area, next, prev, min_vnum );
        top_area++;
        load_objects_sql( tarea );
        load_rooms_sql( tarea );
        load_mobs_sql( tarea );
        fix_area_exits( tarea );
        reset_area( tarea );
        save_area( tarea, FALSE, FALSE );
        fix_exits();
        ch_println( ch, "&C%s&z has been successfully enabled.", tarea->shortname );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "disable" ) )
    {
        if ( !tarea->enabled )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&R%s has an inconsistent load state and cannot be disabled." );
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( tarea->shortname, "limbo.are" ) || !str_cmp( tarea->shortname, "vships.are" ) || !str_cmp( tarea->shortname, "vstructures.are" ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&RYou cannot disable that area." );
            return;
        }

        unload_mobs( tarea, FALSE );
        unload_objects( tarea, FALSE );
        unload_rooms( tarea );

        tarea->enabled = FALSE;
        tarea->state_changed = time( 0 );
        UNLINK( tarea, first_area, last_area, next, prev );
        LINK_SORT_NAME( tarea, AREA_DATA, first_area_archive, last_area_archive, next, prev, shortname );
        top_area--;
        save_area( tarea, FALSE, FALSE );
        fix_exits();
        ch_println( ch, "&C%s&z has been successfully disabled.", tarea->shortname );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "notes" ) )
    {
        ch->substate = SUB_EDIT_AREA;
        buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
        buffer->buf1 = tarea;
        start_editing( ch, FUNC, tarea->notes );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "name" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> name <&wvalue&C>" );
            return;
        }

        for ( AREA_DATA* uarea = first_area; uarea; uarea = uarea->next )
        {
            if ( !str_cmp( uarea->name, argument ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "There is already an area with that name." );
                return;
            }
        }

        SET_STRING( tarea->name, argument );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "shortname" ) )
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
        if ( NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> shortname <&wnew shortname&C>" );
            return;
        }

        for ( AREA_DATA* pArea = first_area; pArea; pArea = pArea->next )
        {
            if ( !str_cmp( pArea->shortname, arg3 ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "An active area with that shortname already exists." );
                return;
            }
        }

        for ( AREA_DATA* pArea = first_area_archive; pArea; pArea = pArea->next )
        {
            if ( !str_cmp( pArea->shortname, arg1 ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "An archived area with that shortname already exists." );
                return;
            }
        }

        int rval;
        if ( (rval = begin_sql_transaction()) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
        {
            bug( "failed to begin transaction when updating area shortname: %s", lotj_strerror(rval) );
            return;
        }

        // Do all our updates in one transaction, use custom queries instead of normal upsert to ensure it's transactional
        char query[MSL];
        snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET shortname=%s WHERE shortname=%s", DB_TABLE_AREAS, sql_escape_string(arg3), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
        query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );
        snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET area=%s WHERE area=%s", DB_TABLE_ROOMS, sql_escape_string(arg3), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
        query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );
        snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET area=%s WHERE area=%s", DB_TABLE_MOBS, sql_escape_string(arg3), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
        query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );
        snprintf( query, MSL, "UPDATE %s SET area=%s WHERE area=%s", DB_TABLE_OBJECTS, sql_escape_string(arg3), sql_escape_string(tarea->shortname) );
        query_db2( query, NULL, NULL );

        if ( (rval = commit_sql_transaction()) != E_LOTJ_SUCCESS )
        {
            bug( "failed to commit transaction when updating area shortname: %s", lotj_strerror(rval) );
            return;
        }

        if ( tarea->planet )
            save_planet( tarea->planet, false );

        SET_STRING( tarea->shortname, arg3 );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "vnums" ) )
    {
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );
        
        if ( !is_number( arg3 ) || !is_number( arg4 ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> vnums <&wmin vnum&C> <&wmax vnum&C>" );
            return;
        }

        int new_min = atoi( arg3 );
        int new_max = atoi( arg4 );

        if ( new_min > new_max )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "New maximum must be greater than new minimum." );
            return;
        }

        // Check for other areas which overlap with the new range
        for ( AREA_DATA* a = first_area; a; a = a->next )
        {
            if ( a == tarea )
                continue;

            if ( new_max >= a->min_vnum && new_min <= a->max_vnum )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "That vnum range conflicts with existing area %s (%d - %d)", a->shortname, a->min_vnum, a->max_vnum );
                return;
            }
        }

        // Fail if any current mobs/objects/rooms would be orphaned by this change
        for ( int vnum = tarea->min_vnum; vnum <= tarea->max_vnum; vnum++ )
        {
            // Ignore anything still in the new range
            if ( vnum >= new_min && vnum <= new_max )
                continue;
            
            if ( get_room_index( vnum ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Room %d would be orphaned. Delete it or include it in the new range.", vnum );
                return;
            }
            if ( get_mob_index( vnum ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Mob %d would be orphaned. Delete it or include it in the new range.", vnum );
                return;
            }
            if ( get_obj_index( vnum ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Object %d would be orphaned. Delete it or include it in the new range.", vnum );
                return;
            }
        }

        tarea->min_vnum = new_min;
        tarea->max_vnum = new_max;
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "planet" ) )
    {
        PLANET_DATA* planet;
        planet = get_planet( argument );

        if ( tarea->planet )
        {
            UNLINK_LNODE( AREA_DATA_LNODE, tarea, tarea->planet->first_area, tarea->planet->last_area );
            tarea->planet->ai_room_cnt = 0;
            tarea->planet->ai_pad_cnt = 0;
            DISPOSE( tarea->planet->ai_rooms );
            DISPOSE( tarea->planet->ai_pads );
            tarea->planet = NULL;
        }

        if ( planet )
        {
            if ( xIS_SET( planet->flags, PLANET_STAR ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "You can't place a area on a star!" );
                return;
            }

            tarea->planet = planet;
            tarea->planet->ai_room_cnt = 0;
            tarea->planet->ai_pad_cnt = 0;
            DISPOSE( tarea->planet->ai_rooms );
            DISPOSE( tarea->planet->ai_pads );
            LINK_LNODE( AREA_DATA_LNODE, tarea, planet->first_area, planet->last_area );
        }

        if ( !planet && argument[0] != '\0' )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Planet \"%s\" unmatched. Please try again.", argument );
            return;
        }

        if ( planet != NULL )
            save_planet( planet, true );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "clan" ) )
    {
        CLAN_DATA* clan = NULL;
        
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset %s clan <&wclan name&C>", arg1 );
            ch_println( ch, "&z        &Caset %s clan none", arg1 );
            return;
        }

        clan = get_clan( argument );

        if ( !str_cmp( argument, "none" ) )
        {
            tarea->clan = NULL;
            SET_STRING( tarea->clan_name, NULL );
            ch_println( ch, "&zClan value for &C%s&z cleared.", tarea->name );
        }
        else if ( !clan )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zClan &C%s&z not found.", argument );
        }
        else
        {
            tarea->clan = clan;
            SET_STRING( tarea->clan_name, clan->name );
            ch_println( ch, "&zThe clan for &C%s&z has been set to &C%s&z.", tarea->name, tarea->clan->name );
        }
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "hail" ) ) //Sintaka - customized hail OLC
    {
        HAIL_DATA* pHail;
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );

        if ( arg3[0] == '\0' || arg4[0] == '\0' )
        {
            send_to_char( "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> hail <&wname&C> <&wvnum&C>&w\n       &Caset <&wshortname&C> hail <&wname&C> remove&w", ch );
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg4, "remove" ) )
        {
            bool removed = FALSE;

            for ( pHail = tarea->first_hail; pHail; pHail = pHail->next )
            {
                if ( !str_cmp( arg3, pHail->name ) )
                {
                    ch_println( ch, "&C%s&z hail location removed.", pHail->name );
                    UNLINK( pHail, tarea->first_hail, tarea->last_hail, next, prev );
                    FREE_STRUCT_NORET( pHail, hail_point_fields );
                    removed = TRUE;
                    save_area( tarea, false, true );
                    return;
                }
            }

            if ( !removed )
                ch_println( ch, "Hail location not found" );

            return;
        }

        if ( !is_number( arg4 ) )
        {
            send_to_char( "Enter a Vnum for the hail location or enter Remove to delete", ch );
            return;
        }

        arg3[0] = toupper( arg3[0] ); //Capitalize the hail location
        int vnum = atoi( arg4 );
        CREATE( pHail, HAIL_DATA, 1 );
        SET_STRING( pHail->name, arg3 );
        pHail->vnum = vnum;
        LINK( pHail, tarea->first_hail, tarea->last_hail, next, prev );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "low_economy" ) )
    {
        if ( !is_number( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> low_economy <&wvalue&C>" );
            return;
        }
        tarea->low_economy = atoi( argument );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "high_economy" ) )
    {
        if ( !is_number( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> high_economy <&wvalue&C>" );
            return;
        }
        tarea->high_economy = atoi( argument );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "author" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> author <&wvalue&C>" );
            return;
        }
        SET_STRING( tarea->author, argument );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "resetmsg" ) )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> resetmsg <&wvalue&C>" );
            return;
        }

        SET_STRING( tarea->resetmsg, str_cmp( argument, "clear" ) ? argument : NULL );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    } /* Rennard */

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "ambience" ) )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( argument, "low" ) )
            tarea->ambience = 1;
        else if ( !str_cmp( argument, "medium" ) )
            tarea->ambience = 2;
        else if ( !str_cmp( argument, "high" ) )
            tarea->ambience = 3;
        else
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> ambiance <&wlow | medium | high&C>" );
            return;
        }

        if ( tarea->ambience == 1 )
            ch_println( ch, "Ambience level set to LOW. (YELL Range is 6 rooms)" );

        if ( tarea->ambience == 2 )
            ch_println( ch, "Ambience level set to MEDIUM. (YELL Range is 4 rooms)" );

        if ( tarea->ambience == 3 )
            ch_println( ch, "Ambience level set to HIGH. (YELL Range is 2 rooms)" );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "resetfreq" ) )
    {
        if ( !is_number( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset <&wshortname&C> resetfreq <&wvalue in minutes&C>" );
            return;
        }
        tarea->reset_frequency = atoi( argument );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "flags" ) )
    {
        tarea->flags = set_flags( ch, area_flags, tarea->flags, argument, true );
        save_area( tarea, false, true );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "builders" ) )
    {
        char buf[MSL];
        strlcpy( buf, "", MSL );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );

        if ( NULLSTR( arg3 ) || ( str_cmp( arg3, "add" ) && str_cmp( arg3, "remove" ) && str_cmp( arg3, "clear" ) ) || ( str_cmp( arg3, "clear" ) && NULLSTR( arg4 ) ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Caset %s builders <&wadd&C/&wremove&C> [name]", tarea->shortname );
            ch_println( ch, "&z        &Caset %s builders clear", tarea->shortname );
            return;
        }

        if ( !str_cmp( arg3, "clear" ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( tarea->builders, "" );
            save_area( tarea, false, true );
            ch_println( ch, "Done." );
            return;
        }
        else if ( !str_cmp( arg3, "add" ) )
        {
            if ( !NULLSTR( tarea->builders ) && nifty_is_name( arg4, tarea->builders ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "&C%s&z is already assigned as a builder for &C%s&z.", arg4, tarea->shortname );
                return;
            }

            if ( !NULLSTR( tarea->builders ) )
                snprintf( buf, MSL, "%s ", tarea->builders );
            snprintf( buf + strlen( buf ), MSL - strlen( buf ), "%s", arg4 );

            SET_STRING( tarea->builders, buf );
            save_area( tarea, false, true );
            ch_println( ch, "&zYou have added &C%s&z as a builder for &C%s&z.", arg4, tarea->shortname );
            return;
        }
        else if ( !str_cmp( arg3, "remove" ) )
        {
            if ( NULLSTR( tarea->builders ) || !nifty_is_name( arg4, tarea->builders ) )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "&C%s&z is not assigned as a builder for &C%s&z.", arg4, tarea->shortname );
                return;
            }

            snprintf( buf, MSL, "%s", remove_substr_from_str( tarea->builders, arg4 ) );
            SET_STRING( tarea->builders, buf );
            save_area( tarea, false, true );
            ch_println( ch, "&zYou have removed &C%s&z as a builder from &C%s&z.", arg4, tarea->shortname );
            return;
        }

        return;
    }

    do_aset( ch, "" );
    return;
}

AREA_DATA* area_from_vnum( int vnum )
{
    if ( vnum <= 0 )
        return NULL;
    
    for ( AREA_DATA* result = first_area; result; result = result->next )
        if ( vnum >= result->min_vnum && vnum <= result->max_vnum )
            return result;
    
    return NULL;
}

CMDF do_rfill( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = NULL;
    AREA_DATA* tArea = NULL;
    char arg1[MIL], arg2[MIL];
    int vnum = 0, lrange = 0, trange = 0, cnt = 0;

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) || NULLSTR( arg2 ) || !is_number( arg1 ) || !is_number( arg2 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &CRFILL <&wfirst vnum&C> <&wlast vnum&C> [Optional Room Name]" );
        return;
    }

    lrange = atoi( arg1 );
    trange = atoi( arg2 );

    if ( lrange >= trange )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&RThats not a valid range. Try again." );
        return;
    }

    tArea = area_from_vnum( lrange );
    
    if ( !tArea || tArea != area_from_vnum( trange ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "That range isn't encompassed in a single area." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_build( ch, tArea ) )
        return;

    for ( vnum = lrange; vnum <= trange; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( ( room = get_room_index( vnum ) ) == NULL )
        {
            room = make_room( vnum, TRUE );

            if ( !room )
            {
                bug( "RFILL: make_room failed - RFILL Aborted", 0 );
                return;
            }

            if ( !NULLSTR( argument ) )
            {
                SET_STRING( room->name, argument );
                save_room( room, true );
            }

            cnt++;
            continue;
        }
    }

    ch_println( ch, "&zCreated &C%d&z rooms in the range of &C%d&z to &C%d&z.", cnt, lrange, trange );
    ch_println( ch, "&z(&CC&z)ompleted RFILL Command." );
    return;
}

CMDF do_rlist( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = NULL;
    char aname[MIL], arg1[MIL], arg2[MIL];
    AREA_DATA* tarea = NULL;
    int vnum = 0, lrange = 0, trange = 0, sector_num = -1;
    bool aispawn = false, sector = false;
    strlcpy( aname, "", MIL );

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) )
        tarea = ch->in_room ? ch->in_room->area : NULL;
    else if ( is_number( arg1 ) && is_number( arg2 ) )
    {
        lrange = atoi( arg1 );
        trange = atoi( arg2 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    }
    else if ( str_cmp( arg1, "sector" ) && str_cmp( arg1, "aispawn" ) )
    {
        tarea = get_area( arg1 );
        if ( !tarea )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&wCould not find area &C%s&w.", arg1 );
            return;
        }
        strlcpy( arg1, arg2, MIL );
        argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    }
    else
        tarea = ch->in_room ? ch->in_room->area : NULL;

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "sector" ) )
    {
        sector = true;
        if ( NULLSTR( arg2 ) || !is_number( arg2 ) || ( sector_num = atoi( arg2 ) ) < 0 || sector_num >= SECT_MAX )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&wInvalid sector choice. Please choose between &C0&w and &C%d&w", SECT_MAX - 1 );
            return;
        }
    }
    else if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "aispawn" ) )
        aispawn = true;

    if ( !tarea && ( lrange <= 0 || trange <= 0 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Crlist" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist <&warea shortname&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist <&wlow vnum&C <&whigh vnum&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist aispawn" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist <&warea shortname&C> aispawn" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist <&wlow vnum&C> <&whigh vnum&C> aispawn" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist sector <&wsector #&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist <&warea shortname&C> sector <&wsector #&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crlist <&wlow vnum&C> <&whigh vnum&C> sector <&wsector #&C>" );
        return;
    }

    if ( tarea )
    {
        lrange = tarea->min_vnum;
        trange = tarea->max_vnum;
    }

    if ( lrange >= trange )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "The high vnum must be greater than the low vnum." );
        return;
    }

    for ( vnum = lrange; vnum <= trange; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( ( room = get_room_index( vnum ) ) == NULL )
            continue;

        if ( !can_rmodify( ch, room ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You do not have permission to access/modify one of the rooms in that range." );
            return;
        }
    }

    for ( vnum = lrange; vnum <= trange; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( ( room = get_room_index( vnum ) ) == NULL )
            continue;

        if ( aispawn && !is_valid_ai_room( room ) )
            continue;

        if ( sector_num != -1 && room->sector_type != sector_num )
            continue;

        if ( !sector )
        {
            //Some areas have such a huge rlist that without pager, you'll d/c. Gathorn 7May16
            pager_println( ch, "&C%5d&z) &w%-40s %-9s %s%s%s", vnum, stripclr( room->name ),
                          !xIS_SET( room->flags, ROOM_COMMAND ) ? "         " : "&C[Command]&w",
                          ( room->description[0] != '\0' ) ? "&w " : "&z*&CNo Desc&z*&w", room->first_mprog != NULL ? "&R*&w" : "",  !NULLSTR( room->lprog_code ) ? "&G*&w" : "" );
        }
        else
        {
            char sectorstr[MIL];

            if ( room->sector_type < 0 || room->sector_type >= SECT_MAX )
                snprintf( sectorstr, MIL, "&z[&r%d&w: &Rundefined&z]&w", room->sector_type );
            else
                snprintf( sectorstr, MIL, "&z[&C%d&w:&C %s&z]&w", room->sector_type, sectortypes[ room->sector_type ] );

            //Some areas have such a huge rlist that without pager, you'll d/c. Gathorn 7May16
            pager_println( ch, "&C%5d&z) %14s &w%-40s %-9s %s%s%s", vnum, sectorstr, stripclr( room->name ),
                          !xIS_SET( room->flags, ROOM_COMMAND ) ? "         " : "&C[Command]&w",
                          ( room->description[0] != '\0' ) ? "&w " : "&z*&CNo Desc&z*&w", room->first_mprog != NULL ? "&R*&w" : "",  !NULLSTR( room->lprog_code ) ? "&G*&w" : "" );	  
        }
    }

    return;
}

/* New command added by Sintaka to show UNUSED rooms in an area */
CMDF do_frlist( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room;
    int vnum, lrange, trange, count = 1;
    char arg1[MIL];
    char arg2[MIL];
    AREA_DATA*        tarea;

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    tarea = ch->in_room ? ch->in_room->area : NULL;

    if ( !can_build( ch, tarea ) )
        return;

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( tarea )
    {
        if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) )           /* cleaned a big scary mess */
            lrange = tarea->min_vnum;    /* here.        -Thoric */
        else
            lrange = atoi( arg1 );

        if ( NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
            trange = tarea->max_vnum;
        else
            trange = atoi( arg2 );
    }
    else
    {
        lrange = ( is_number( arg1 ) ? atoi( arg1 ) : 1 );
        trange = ( is_number( arg2 ) ? atoi( arg2 ) : 1 );
    }

    ch_println( ch, "Available Vnums:" );

    for ( vnum = lrange; vnum <= trange; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( ( room = get_room_index( vnum ) ) == NULL )
        {
            if ( count % 4 == 0 )
                ch_println( ch, "%-10d", vnum );
            else
                ch_printf( ch, "%-10d", vnum );

            count++;
        }
    }

    return;
}

AREA_DATA* area_from_id( int id )
{
    AREA_DATA* area = NULL;

    if ( id <= 0 )
        return NULL;
    
    for ( area = first_area; area; area = area->next )
        if ( area->id == id )
            break;
    
    return area;
}

AREA_DATA* get_area( const char* name )
{
    AREA_DATA* result = NULL;

    if ( NULLSTR( name ) )
        return NULL;

    for ( result = first_area; result; result = result->next )
        if ( !str_cmp( name, result->shortname ) )
            break;
            
    return result;
}

AREA_DATA* get_archived_area( const char* name )
{
    AREA_DATA* result = NULL;

    if ( NULLSTR( name ) )
        return NULL;

    for ( result = first_area_archive; result; result = result->next )
        if ( !str_cmp( name, result->shortname ) )
            break;
            
    return result;
}

CMDF do_mlist( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
