    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) )
        tarea = ch->in_room ? ch->in_room->area : NULL;
    else if ( is_number( arg1 ) && is_number( arg2 ) )
    {
        lrange = atoi( arg1 );
        trange = atoi( arg2 );
    }
    else
    {
        tarea = get_area( arg1 );
        if ( !tarea )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&wCould not find area &C%s&w.", arg1 );
            return;
        }
    }

    if ( !tarea && ( lrange <= 0 || trange <= 0 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cmlist" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Cmlist <&warea shortname&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Cmlist <&wlow vnum&C> <&whigh vnum&C>" );
        return;
    }

    if ( tarea )
    {
        lrange = tarea->min_vnum;
        trange = tarea->max_vnum;
    }

    if ( lrange >= trange )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "The high vnum must be greater than the low vnum." );
        return;
    }

    for ( vnum = lrange; vnum <= trange; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( ( mob = get_mob_index( vnum ) ) == NULL )
            continue;

        if ( !can_medit( ch, mob ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "You do not have permission to access/modify one of the mobiles in that range." );
            return;
        }
    }

    for ( vnum = lrange; vnum <= trange; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( ( mob = get_mob_index( vnum ) ) == NULL )
            continue;

        //Some areas have such a huge mlist that without pager, you'll d/c. Gathorn 7May16
        pager_printf( ch, "&C%5d&z) &w%-20s &R'&w%s&R'&w%s%s\n", vnum,
                      mob->player_name,
                      mob->short_descr,
                      mob->first_mprog != NULL ? "&R *&w" : "", !NULLSTR( mob->lprog_code ) ? "&G*&w" : "" );
    }

    return;
}

void mpedit( CHAR_DATA* ch, MPROG_DATA* mprog, int mptype, char* argument )
{
    BUFFER_DATA* buffer = NULL;

    if ( is_busy( ch ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
        return;
    }

    if ( mptype != -1 )
    {
        mprog->type = 1 << mptype;
        SET_STRING( mprog->arglist, argument );
    }

    ch->substate = SUB_MPROG_EDIT;
    buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
    if ( !buffer ) buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
    buffer->buf1 = mprog;

    if ( !mprog->comlist )
        SET_STRING( mprog->comlist, "" );

    start_editing_prog( ch, FUNC, mprog->comlist );
    return;
}

/*
    Mobprogram editing - cumbersome                -Thoric
*/
CMDF do_mpedit( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg1 [MIL], arg2 [MIL], arg3 [MIL], arg4 [MIL];
    CHAR_DATA* victim = NULL;
    MPROG_DATA* mprog = NULL, *mprog2 = NULL;
    int value = 0, mptype = 0, cnt = 0;
    BUFFER_DATA* buffer = NULL;
    TIMEPROG_DATA* tp = NULL;

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Mob's can't mpedit" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !ch->desc )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You have no descriptor" );
        return;
    }

    switch ( ch->substate )
    {
        default:
            break;

        case SUB_RESTRICTED:
            ch_println( ch, "You can't use this command from within another command." );
            return;

        case SUB_MPROG_EDIT:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, "mpedit" );

            if ( buffer )
            {
                mprog = ( MPROG_DATA* )buffer->buf1;
                victim = buffer->target;
                dispose_buffer( buffer );
            }

            if ( !mprog )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Fatal error: report to Thori-- err... Nield." );
                bug( "do_mpedit: sub_mprog_edit: NULL buffer", 0 );
                ch->substate = SUB_NONE;
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }

            SET_STRING( mprog->comlist, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            if ( victim && victim->pIndexData )
            {
                save_mob( victim->pIndexData, TRUE );
                if ( ( mprog->type & TIME_PROG ) || ( mprog->type & HOUR_PROG ) )
                {
                    for ( CHAR_DATA* tch = first_char; tch; tch = tch->next )
                    {
                        if ( tch->tmprog )
                            continue;
    
                        if ( !IS_NPC( tch ) )
                            continue;
                        
                        if ( tch->pIndexData != victim->pIndexData )
                            continue;
                            
                        CREATE( tp, TIMEPROG_DATA, 1 );
                        tp->tch = tch;
                        tch->tmprog = tp;
                        LINK( tp, first_timeprog, last_timeprog, next, prev );
                    }
                }
            }

            return;
    }

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
    value = atoi( arg3 );

    if ( arg1[0] == '\0' || arg2[0] == '\0' )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Cmpedit <&wvictim&C> <&wcommand&C> [&wnumber&C] <&wprogram&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
        ch_println( ch, "" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zCommand being one of:" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Badd delete insert edit list shortlist" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zProgram being one of:" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bact speech rand fight hitprcnt greet allgreet" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bentry give bribe death time hour script keyword" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Buse (actually found target prog but need to fix naming)" );
        return;
    }

    if ( ( victim = get_char_room( ch, arg1 ) ) == NULL )
    {
        if ( get_trust( ch ) < LEVEL_GOD || ( victim = get_char_world_full( ch, arg1 ) ) == NULL )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Could not find that NPC." );
            return;
        }
    }

    if ( !IS_NPC( victim ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "They're not an NPC!" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_mmodify( ch, victim ) )
        return;

    if ( !xIS_SET( victim->act, ACT_PROTOTYPE ) && get_trust( ch ) <= LEVEL_PR && !is_name( "prog", ch->pcdata->bestowments ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "A mobile must have a prototype flag to be mpset." );
        return;
    }

    set_char_color( AT_GREEN, ch );

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "list" ) )
    {
        cnt = 0;

        if ( !victim->pIndexData->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That mobile has no mob programs." );
            return;
        }

        for ( mprog = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
            ch_println( ch, "&C%d&z>&B%s &C%s&w\n%s", ++cnt, mprog_type_to_name( mprog->type ), mprog->arglist, mprog->comlist );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "shortlist" ) )
    {
        cnt = 0;

        if ( !victim->pIndexData->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That mobile has no mob programs." );
            return;
        }

        for ( mprog = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
            ch_println( ch, "&C%d&z>&B%s &C%s&w", ++cnt, mprog_type_to_name( mprog->type ), mprog->arglist );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "edit" ) )
    {
        if ( !victim->pIndexData->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That mobile has no mob programs." );
            return;
        }

        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );

        if ( !NULLSTR( arg4 ) )
        {
            mptype = get_mpflag( arg4 );

            if ( mptype == -1 )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Unknown program type." );
                return;
            }
        }
        else
            mptype = -1;

        if ( value < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }

        cnt = 0;

        for ( mprog = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( ++cnt == value )
            {
                buffer = create_buffer( ch, "mpedit" );
                buffer->target = victim;
                mpedit( ch, mprog, mptype, argument );
                victim->pIndexData->progtypes = 0;

                for ( mprog2 = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog2; mprog2 = mprog2->next )
                    victim->pIndexData->progtypes |= mprog2->type;

                return;
            }
        }

        ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "delete" ) )
    {
        int num;

        if ( !victim->pIndexData->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That mobile has no mob programs." );
            return;
        }

        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );

        if ( value < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }

        cnt = 0;

        for ( mprog = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
            if ( ++cnt == value )
                break;
        
        if ( !mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }
    
        mptype = mprog->type;
        cnt = num = 0;

        int tps = 0, hps = 0;

        for ( mprog2 = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog2; mprog2 = mprog2->next )
        {
            if ( IS_SET( mprog->type, mptype ) )
                num++;

            if ( mprog2->type & TIME_PROG )
                tps++;

            if ( mprog2->type & HOUR_PROG )
                hps++;            
        }

        if ( num <= 1 )
            REMOVE_BIT( victim->pIndexData->progtypes, mptype );
        
        if ( ( ( mprog->type & TIME_PROG ) || ( mprog->type & HOUR_PROG ) ) && ( tps + hps ) <= 1 )
        {
            for ( CHAR_DATA* tch = first_char; tch; tch = tch->next )
            {
                if ( !tch->tmprog )
                    continue;

                if ( !IS_NPC( tch ) )
                    continue;
                
                if ( tch->pIndexData != victim->pIndexData )
                    continue;

                UNLINK( tch->tmprog, first_timeprog, last_timeprog, next, prev );
                DISPOSE( tch->tmprog );
            }
        }

        UNLINK( mprog, victim->pIndexData->first_mprog, victim->pIndexData->last_mprog, next, prev ); 
        FREE_STRUCT_NORET( mprog, mprog_fields );        
        save_mob( victim->pIndexData, TRUE );
        ch_println( ch, "Program removed." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "insert" ) )
    {
        if ( !victim->pIndexData->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That mobile has no mob programs." );
            return;
        }

        argument = one_argument( argument, arg4 );
        mptype = get_mpflag( arg4 );

        if ( mptype == -1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Unknown program type." );
            return;
        }

        if ( value < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }

        if ( value == 1 )
        {
            CREATE( mprog, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
            LINK_FRONT( mprog, victim->pIndexData->first_mprog, victim->pIndexData->last_mprog, next, prev );
            victim->pIndexData->progtypes |= ( 1 << mptype );
            buffer = create_buffer( ch, "mpedit" );
            buffer->target = victim;
            mpedit( ch, mprog, mptype, argument );
            return;
        }

        cnt = 1;

        for ( mprog = victim->pIndexData->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( ++cnt == value && mprog->next )
            {
                CREATE( mprog2, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
                victim->pIndexData->progtypes |= ( 1 << mptype );
                buffer = create_buffer( ch, "mpedit" );
                buffer->target = victim;
                mpedit( ch, mprog2, mptype, argument );
                INSERT_AFTER( mprog, mprog2, victim->pIndexData->last_mprog, next, prev );
                return;
            }
        }

        ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "add" ) )
    {
        mptype = get_mpflag( arg3 );

        if ( mptype == -1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Unknown program type." );
            return;
        }

        CREATE( mprog, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
        LINK( mprog, victim->pIndexData->first_mprog, victim->pIndexData->last_mprog, next, prev );
        victim->pIndexData->progtypes    |= ( 1 << mptype );
        buffer = create_buffer( ch, "mpedit" );
        buffer->target = victim;
        mpedit( ch, mprog, mptype, argument );
        return;
    }

    do_mpedit( ch, "" );
}

    if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Crpedit <&wcommand&C> [&wnumber&C] <&wprogram&C> <&wvalue&C>&w" );
        ch_println( ch, "" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zCommand being one of:" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Badd delete insert edit list shortlist" );
        ch_println( ch, "&zProgram being one of:" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bact speech rand sleep rest rfight entry" );
        ch_println( ch, "  &Bleave death " );
        ch_println( ch, "" );
        ch_println( ch, "&wYou should be standing in room you wish to edit." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_rmodify( ch, ch->in_room ) )
        return;

    set_char_color( AT_GREEN, ch );

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "list" ) )
    {
        cnt = 0;

        if ( !ch->in_room->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "This room has no room programs." );
            return;
        }

        for ( mprog = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
            ch_println( ch, "&C%d&z>&B%s &C%s&w\n%s", ++cnt, mprog_type_to_name( mprog->type ), mprog->arglist, mprog->comlist );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "shortlist" ) )
    {
        cnt = 0;

        if ( !ch->in_room->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "This room has no room programs." );
            return;
        }

        for ( mprog = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
            ch_println( ch, "&C%d&z>&B%s &C%s&w", ++cnt, mprog_type_to_name( mprog->type ), mprog->arglist );

        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "edit" ) )
    {
        if ( !ch->in_room->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "This room has no room programs." );
            return;
        }

        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );

        if ( !NULLSTR( arg3 ) )
        {
            mptype = get_mpflag( arg3 );

            if ( mptype == -1 )
            {
                ch_println( ch, "Unknown program type." );
                return;
            }
        }
        else
            mptype = -1;

        if ( value < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }

        cnt = 0;

        for ( mprog = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( ++cnt == value )
            {
                mpedit( ch, mprog, mptype, argument );
                ch->in_room->progtypes = 0;

                for ( mprog2 = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog2; mprog2 = mprog2->next )
                    ch->in_room->progtypes |= mprog2->type;

                return;
            }
        }

        ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "delete" ) )
    {
        int num;

        if ( !ch->in_room->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That room has no room programs." );
            return;
        }

        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );

        if ( value < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }

        cnt = 0;

        for ( mprog = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
            if ( ++cnt == value )
                break;
        
        if ( !mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }
        
        mptype = mprog->type;
        cnt = num = 0;
        int tps = 0, hps = 0;

        for ( mprog2 = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog2; mprog2 = mprog2->next )
        {
            if ( IS_SET( mprog->type, mptype ) )
                num++;

            if ( mprog2->type & TIME_PROG )
                tps++;

            if ( mprog2->type & HOUR_PROG )
                hps++;      
        }

        if ( ch->in_room->tmprog && ( ( mprog->type & TIME_PROG ) || ( mprog->type & HOUR_PROG ) ) && ( tps + hps ) <= 1 )
        {
            UNLINK( ch->in_room->tmprog, first_timeprog, last_timeprog, next, prev );
            DISPOSE( ch->in_room->tmprog );
        }

        UNLINK( mprog, ch->in_room->first_mprog, ch->in_room->last_mprog, next, prev );
        FREE_STRUCT_NORET( mprog, mprog_fields );

        if ( num <= 1 )
            REMOVE_BIT( ch->in_room->progtypes, mptype );

        ch_println( ch, "Program removed." );
        save_room( ch->in_room, TRUE );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg2, "insert" ) )
    {
        if ( !ch->in_room->first_mprog )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "That room has no room programs." );
            return;
        }

        argument = one_argument( argument, arg3 );
        mptype = get_mpflag( arg2 );

        if ( mptype == -1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Unknown program type." );
            return;
        }

        if ( value < 1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
            return;
        }

        if ( value == 1 )
        {
            CREATE( mprog, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
            ch->in_room->progtypes |= ( 1 << mptype );
            mpedit( ch, mprog, mptype, argument );
            LINK_FRONT( mprog, ch->in_room->first_mprog, ch->in_room->last_mprog, next, prev );
            save_room( ch->in_room, TRUE );
            return;
        }

        cnt = 1;

        for ( mprog = ch->in_room->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
        {
            if ( ++cnt == value && mprog->next )
            {
                CREATE( mprog2, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
                ch->in_room->progtypes |= ( 1 << mptype );
                mpedit( ch, mprog2, mptype, argument );
                INSERT_AFTER( mprog, mprog2, ch->in_room->last_mprog, next, prev );
                return;
            }
        }

        ch_println( ch, "Program not found." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( arg1, "add" ) )
    {
        mptype = get_mpflag( arg2 );

        if ( mptype == -1 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Unknown program type." );
            return;
        }

        CREATE( mprog, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
        LINK( mprog, ch->in_room->first_mprog, ch->in_room->last_mprog, next, prev );
        ch->in_room->progtypes |= ( 1 << mptype );
        mpedit( ch, mprog, mptype, argument );
        return;
    }

    do_rpedit( ch, "" );
}

CMDF do_rdelete( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg[MIL];
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* location;
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );

    /*  Temporarily disable this command.
        return; */

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Delete which room?" );
        return;
    }

    /* Find the room. */
    if ( ( location = find_location( ch, arg ) ) == NULL )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "No such location." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_build( ch, location->area ) )
        return;

    /* We could go to the trouble of clearing out the room, but why? */
    /* Delete_room does that anyway, but this is probably safer */
    if ( location->first_person || location->first_content )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "The room must be empty first." );
        return;
    }

    /*  Ok, we've determined that the room exists, it is empty and the
        player has the authority to delete it, so let's dump the thing.
        The function to do it is in db.c so it can access the top-room
        variable. */
    ch_println( ch, "&zDeleting room &C%d &z(%s&z).", location->vnum, location->name );
    destroy_lockers( location->vnum, location->vnum, TRUE );
    delete_room( location );
    fix_exits(); /* Need to call this to solve a crash */
    return;
}

/* rdig command by Dracones */
CMDF do_rdig( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char buf [MSL], arg [MIL], tmpcmd[SUB_MSL];
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* location = NULL, *ch_location = NULL;
    AREA_DATA* pArea = NULL;
    EXIT_DATA* xit = NULL;
    int vnum = 0, edir = 0;
    set_char_color( AT_PLAIN, ch );

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    
    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Dig out a new room or dig into an existing room." );
        ch_println( ch, "Usage: rdig <dir>" );
        return;
    }

    ch_location = ch->in_room;
    pArea = ch_location->area;

    if ( !can_build( ch, pArea ) )
        return;

    edir = get_dir( arg );
    xit = get_exit( ch_location, edir );

    if ( !xit )
    {
        vnum = pArea->min_vnum;

        while ( vnum <= pArea->max_vnum && get_room_index( vnum ) != NULL )
        {
            vnum++;
        }

        if ( vnum > pArea->max_vnum )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "No empty upper rooms could be found." );
            return;
        }

        snprintf( buf, MSL, "Digging out room %d to the %s.\n", vnum, arg );
        send_to_char( buf, ch );
        location = make_room( vnum, TRUE );

        if ( !location )
        {
            bug( "rdig: make_room failed", 0 );
            return;
        }

        snprintf( tmpcmd, SUB_MSL, "bexit %s %d", arg, vnum );
        do_redit( ch, tmpcmd );
    }
    else
    {
        vnum = xit->vnum;
        location = get_room_index( vnum );
        snprintf( buf, MSL, "Digging into room %d to the %s.\n", vnum, arg );
        send_to_char( buf, ch );
    }

    SET_STRING( location->name, ch_location->name );
    SET_STRING( location->description, ch_location->description );
    SET_STRING( location->nightdesc, ch_location->nightdesc );
    location->sector_type = ch_location->sector_type;
    location->flags = ch_location->flags;
    save_room( location, true );
    snprintf( buf, MSL, "%d", vnum );
    do_goto( ch, buf );
    return;
}

/*
    Makes a exact copy of a room to another room vnum.
    Syntax: RCOPY <from vnum> <to vnum>
    -Ghost
*/
CMDF do_rcopy( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL];
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = NULL, *target = NULL;

    IMM_CHECK( ch );

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Copy which room? RCOPY <from> <to>" );
        return;
    }

    /* Find the room. */
    if ( ( room = find_location( ch, arg ) ) == NULL )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Invalid room for <FROM>. RCOPY <from> <to>" );
        return;
    }

    if ( NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
        snprintf( arg2, MIL, "%d", ch->in_room->vnum );

    /* Find the room. */
    if ( ( target = find_location( ch, arg2 ) ) == NULL )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Invalid room for <TO>. RCOPY <from> <to>" );
        return;
    }

    if ( room->vnum == target->vnum ) //Crash prevention. Gathorn 2 July 2017
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You cannot copy a room onto itself." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_build( ch, room->area ) || !can_build( ch, target->area ) )
        return;

    SET_STRING( target->name, room->name );
    SET_STRING( target->description, room->description );
    SET_STRING( target->nightdesc, room->nightdesc );
    target->sector_type = room->sector_type;
    target->flags = room->flags;
    if ( xIS_SET( target->flags, ROOM_EMPTY_HOME ) && !target->phome )
    {
        PHOME_DATA* home = NULL;
        CREATE( home, PHOME_DATA, 1 );
        SET_STRING( home->owner, "" );
        home->price = PHOME_DEFAULT_PRICE;
        target->phome = home;
    }
    save_room( target, true );
}

// Goes through a list of rooms and initializes all lprogs
int init_room_lprogs( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* first )
{
    int cnt = 0;
    for ( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = first; room; room = room->next )
    {
        if ( !NULLSTR( room->lprog_code ) )
        {
            LUA_PROGRAM *pLprog;
            LUA_PARAM params[] = {{ .type = LUA_PARAM_ROOM, .payload = ( void* ) room, .global_name = "self"},
                { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST }};
            pLprog = lua_load_from_buffer( room_lprog_identifier( room ), room->lprog_code, NULL, params );
            pLprog->room = room;
            cnt++;
        }
    }

    return cnt;
}

void _copy_resets( RESET_DATA* source_first, RESET_DATA** template_first, RESET_DATA** template_last );
void _copy_resets( RESET_DATA* source_first, RESET_DATA** template_first, RESET_DATA** template_last )
{
    for ( RESET_DATA* source = source_first; source; source = source->next )
    {
        // We don't want door resets in player-built instances. Let players manage them.
        if ( source->command == 'D' )
            continue;

        RESET_DATA* reset = make_reset( source->command, source->arg1, source->arg2, source->arg3 );
        LINK( reset, *template_first, *template_last, next, prev );
        _copy_resets( source->first_child, &reset->first_child, &reset->last_child );
    }
}

void rooms_to_template( int source_first, int source_last, ROOM_INDEX_DATA** template_first, ROOM_INDEX_DATA** template_last )
{
    // When imaging something, any lprogs from the thing's current template should be copied into the new template.
    // To do this, we copy the lprogs from that template to the source rooms. We'll copy them to the template
    // later in the function, then remove them from the rooms since they'll now inherit from the template.
    for ( int vnum = source_first; vnum <= source_last; vnum++ )
    {
        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = get_room_index( vnum );
        if ( !room || !NULLSTR( room->lprog_code ) ) // If the room has its own lprog, that overrides the template
            continue;
        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* template_room = get_room_template( room );
        if ( template_room && !NULLSTR( template_room->lprog_code ) )
            SET_STRING( room->lprog_code, template_room->lprog_code ); // Don't init the lprog, this is only temporary
    }

    // Clean up rooms from the original template
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* next_room;
    for ( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = *template_first; room; room = next_room )
    {
        next_room = room->next;
        unload_room( room );
    }
    *template_first = NULL;
    *template_last = NULL;

    for ( int vnum = source_first; vnum <= source_last; vnum++ )
    {
        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = get_room_index( vnum );
        if ( !room )
            continue;

        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* troom;
        CREATE( troom, ROOM_INDEX_DATA, 1 );

        troom->vnum = vnum - source_first;
        troom->sector_type = room->sector_type;
        troom->tunnel = room->tunnel;
        troom->flags = room->flags;
        xREMOVE_BIT( troom->flags, ROOM_PROTOTYPE );
        troom->minshipclass = room->minshipclass;
        troom->maxshipclass = room->maxshipclass;
        SET_STRING( troom->name, room->name );
        SET_STRING( troom->description, room->description );
        
        FURN_DATA* tfurn;
        for ( FURN_DATA* furn = room->first_furniture; furn; furn = furn->next_in_room )
        {
            CREATE( tfurn, FURN_DATA, 1 );
            tfurn->occupants = 0;
            tfurn->pIndexData = furn->pIndexData;
            tfurn->room = troom;
            tfurn->vnum = troom->vnum;
            LINK( tfurn, troom->first_furniture, troom->last_furniture, next_in_room, prev_in_room );
        }

        MPROG_DATA* tprog;
        for ( MPROG_DATA* prog = room->first_mprog; prog; prog = prog->next )
        {
            CREATE( tprog, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
            tprog->type = prog->type;
            SET_STRING( tprog->arglist, prog->arglist );
            SET_STRING( tprog->comlist, prog->comlist );
            LINK( tprog, troom->first_mprog, troom->last_mprog, next, prev );
        }

        if ( room->lift != NULL )
            copy_turbolift( room->lift, troom );

        EXIT_DATA* texit;
        for ( EXIT_DATA* exit = room->first_exit; exit; exit = exit->next )
        {
            CREATE( texit, EXIT_DATA, 1 );
            texit->vdir = exit->vdir;
            texit->key = exit->key;
            texit->distance = exit->distance;
            texit->vnum = exit->vnum - source_first;
            SET_STRING( texit->description, exit->description );
            SET_STRING( texit->keyword, exit->keyword );
            texit->flags = exit->flags;
            LINK( texit, troom->first_exit, troom->last_exit, next, prev );
        }

        EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed;
        for ( EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* src_ed = room->first_extradesc; src_ed; src_ed = src_ed->next )
        {
            CREATE( ed, EXTRA_DESCR_DATA, 1 );
            SET_STRING( ed->keyword, src_ed->keyword );
            SET_STRING( ed->description, src_ed->description );
            LINK( ed, troom->first_extradesc, troom->last_extradesc, next, prev );
        }

        // If the source room has an lprog, copy it to the template and remove the original copy.
        if ( !NULLSTR( room->lprog_code ) )
        {
            SET_STRING( troom->lprog_code, room->lprog_code );
            LUA_PROGRAM* lprog = get_room_lprog( room );
            if ( lprog )
                lua_program_dispose( lprog );
            SET_STRING( room->lprog_code, NULL );
        }
        
        _copy_resets( room->first_reset, &troom->first_reset, &troom->last_reset );
        
        LINK( troom, *template_first, *template_last, next_in_range, prev_in_range );
    }

    return;
}

int find_room_range( AREA_DATA* area, int count )
{
    int empty_count = 0;
    for ( int vnum = area->min_vnum ; vnum <= area->max_vnum; vnum++ )
    {
        if ( get_room_index( vnum ) == NULL )
        {
            empty_count++;
            if ( empty_count >= count )
                return vnum - empty_count + 1;
        }
        else
        {
            empty_count = 0;
        }
    }

    bug( "Warning: Unable to locate %d rooms in %s.", count, area->shortname );
    return -1;
}

// Creates a chunk of rooms based on the given template room in the given area.
// Looks for a contiguous block of vnums large enough to fit the template and returns
// null if it can't find enough.
ROOM_INDEX_DATA* rooms_from_template( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* template_first, AREA_DATA* area )
{
    int room_count = 0;
    for ( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* r = template_first; r; r = r->next_in_range )
        room_count++;
    
    if ( room_count == 0 )
        return NULL;
    
    int start_vnum = find_room_range( area, room_count );
    if ( start_vnum == -1 )
    {
        bug( "Failed to create rooms from template" );
        return NULL;
    }
    
    // First, create all the rooms.
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* first = NULL;
    for ( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* src = template_first; src; src = src->next_in_range )
    {
        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = make_room( start_vnum + src->vnum, FALSE );
        SET_STRING( room->name, src->name );
        SET_STRING( room->description, src->description );
        SET_STRING( room->lprog_code, src->lprog_code );
        room->flags = src->flags;
        room->sector_type = src->sector_type;
        room->tunnel = src->tunnel;
        room->minshipclass = src->minshipclass;
        room->maxshipclass = src->maxshipclass;

        for ( FURN_DATA* t_furn = src->first_furniture; t_furn; t_furn = t_furn->next_in_room )
        {
            if ( !t_furn->pIndexData )
                continue;

            FURN_DATA* furn;
            CREATE( furn, FURN_DATA, 1 );
            furn->room = room;
            furn->vnum = room->vnum;
            furn->pIndexData = t_furn->pIndexData;
            furn->occupants = 0;
            LINK( furn, room->first_furniture, room->last_furniture, next_in_room, prev_in_room );
            LINK( furn, furn->pIndexData->first_instance, furn->pIndexData->last_instance, next, prev );
        }

        for ( MPROG_DATA* t_prog = src->first_mprog; t_prog; t_prog = t_prog->next )
        {
            MPROG_DATA* prog;
            CREATE( prog, MPROG_DATA, 1 );
            prog->type = t_prog->type;
            SET_STRING( prog->arglist, t_prog->arglist );
            SET_STRING( prog->comlist, t_prog->comlist );
            LINK( prog, room->first_mprog, room->last_mprog, next, prev );
            room->progtypes |= t_prog->type;
        }

        for ( EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* src_ed = src->first_extradesc; src_ed; src_ed = src_ed->next )
        {
            EXTRA_DESCR_DATA* ed;
            CREATE( ed, EXTRA_DESCR_DATA, 1 );
            SET_STRING( ed->keyword, src_ed->keyword );
            SET_STRING( ed->description, src_ed->description );
            LINK( ed, room->first_extradesc, room->last_extradesc, next, prev );
        }

        _copy_resets( src->first_reset, &room->first_reset, &room->last_reset );

        if ( src->lift != NULL )
            copy_turbolift( src->lift, room );
        
        if ( room->lift )
            load_turbolift( room->lift, room, true );
        
        if ( !first )
            first = room;
    }

    // Once we've created the rooms, we can add all the exits.
    for ( ROOM_INDEX_DATA* src = template_first; src; src = src->next_in_range )
    {
        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = get_room_index( start_vnum + src->vnum );
        if ( !room )
            continue;

        for ( EXIT_DATA* t_exit = src->first_exit; t_exit; t_exit = t_exit->next )
        {
            if ( t_exit->vnum < 0 || t_exit->vnum >= room_count )
            {
                bug( "exit to offset %d out of range. Ignoring.", t_exit->vnum );
                continue;
            }

            ROOM_INDEX_DATA* to_room = get_room_index( start_vnum + t_exit->vnum );
            if ( !to_room )
            {
                bug( "exit to offset %d led to non-existent room. Ignoring.", t_exit->vnum );
                continue;
            }

            EXIT_DATA* exit;
            CREATE( exit, EXIT_DATA, 1 );
            exit->vdir = t_exit->vdir;
            exit->key = t_exit->key;
            exit->distance = t_exit->distance;
            exit->vnum = start_vnum + t_exit->vnum;
            exit->to_room = to_room;
            SET_STRING( exit->description, t_exit->description );
            SET_STRING( exit->keyword, t_exit->keyword );
            exit->flags = t_exit->flags;
            LINK( exit, room->first_exit, room->last_exit, next, prev );

            EXIT_DATA* rev_exit = get_exit_to( to_room, rev_dir[exit->vdir], room->vnum );
            if ( rev_exit )
            {
                exit->rexit = rev_exit;
                exit->rvnum = room->vnum;
                rev_exit->rexit = exit;
                rev_exit->rvnum = to_room->vnum;
            }
        }
    }

    // Lastly, reset and queue saving the room.
    for ( int vnum = start_vnum; vnum < start_vnum + room_count; vnum++ )
    {
        ROOM_INDEX_DATA* room = get_room_index( vnum );
        if ( !room )
            continue;
        reset_room( room );
        save_room( room, true );
        if ( !NULLSTR( room->lprog_code ) )
        {
            LUA_PARAM params[] =
            {
                { .type = LUA_PARAM_ROOM, .payload = ( void* ) room, .global_name = "self"},
                { .type = LUA_PARAM_LAST }
            };
            LUA_PROGRAM* lprog = lua_load_from_buffer( room_lprog_identifier( room ), room->lprog_code, NULL, params );
            if ( lprog )
                lprog->room = room;
        }
    }

    return first;
}

CMDF do_rpcopy( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    char arg1 [MIL], arg2 [MIL];
    ROOM_INDEX_DATA* from = NULL, *to = NULL;
    MPROG_DATA* mprog = NULL;
    int cnt = 0, fault = 0;

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "RPCOPY is restricted to real builders, Sorry." );
        return;
    }

    argument = one_argument( argument, arg1 );
    argument = one_argument( argument, arg2 );

    if ( NULLSTR( arg1 ) || !is_number( arg1 ) || ( !NULLSTR( arg2 ) && !is_number( arg2 ) ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&zSyntax: &Crcopy <&wsource vnum&C>" );
        ch_println( ch, "&z        &Crcopy <&wsource vnum&C> <&wdestination vnum&C>" );
        return;
    }

    from = get_room_index( atoi( arg1 ) );

    if ( !from )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Could not find source room." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !NULLSTR( arg2 ) )
        to = get_room_index( atoi( arg2 ) );
    else
        to = ch->in_room;

    if ( !to )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "Could not find destination room." );
        return;
    }

    if ( from == to )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You can't copy a room's programs into itself." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !can_rmodify( ch, to ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "&RYeah right! I'm not thinking so!" );
        return;
    }

    if ( !from->first_mprog )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "The source room has no room programs set." );
        return;
    }

    for ( mprog = from->first_mprog; mprog; mprog = mprog->next )
    {
        if ( !lock_rprog( to, mprog->comlist, mprog->arglist, mprog->type ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "&R[RPCOPY Fault]: Xerox is out of ink. Notify Ghost." );
            fault++;
        }
        else
            cnt++;
    }

    if ( fault > 0 )
        ch_println( ch, "&R%'d&z program%s failed to copy to the target location.", fault, fault != 1 ? "s" : "" );

    ch_println( ch, "&C%'d&z program%s were successfully copied to the target location.", cnt, cnt != 1 ? "s" : "" );
    return;
}

CMDF do_aiset( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument )
{
    AI_DATA* curr_ai = NULL;
    char arg[MIL], arg2[MIL];

    if ( NULLSTR( argument ) )
    {
        send_to_char( "Usage: aiset <ai name OR number> <option>\n"

                retire_ai( curr_ai );

        ch_println( ch, "Nuked a total of %d ai mobs.", cnt );
        return;

    if ( !str_cmp( "create", argument ) )
    {

    for ( curr_ai = first_ai; curr_ai; curr_ai = curr_ai->next )
    {
        if ( !str_cmp( curr_ai->name, arg ) )

        if ( curr_ai->id == atoi( arg ) )

    if ( !curr_ai )

        ch_println( ch, "No AI like that. Use AILIST to see all current AI." );

    if ( !str_cmp( "type", arg2 ) )

            return;

        curr_ai->ai_level = atoi( argument );
        save_persistent_mob( curr_ai->character, true );
        ch_println( ch, "Changed %s's type to %s.", curr_ai->name, ai_string( curr_ai->ai_level ) );

    if ( !str_cmp( "happy", arg2 ) )
    {
        if ( !is_number( argument ) )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Range is 0-100." );
            return;
        }

        if ( atoi( argument ) < 0 || atoi( argument ) > 100 )
        {
            ch_println( ch, "Out of range, 0-100." );
            return;
        }

        curr_ai->happy = atoi( argument );
        save_persistent_mob( curr_ai->character, true );
    }

    if ( !str_cmp( "clan", arg2 ) )
    {
        curr_ai->clan = get_clan( argument );

        if ( curr_ai->clan != NULL )
            SET_STRING( curr_ai->clan_name, curr_ai->clan->name );

        ch_println( ch, "Done." );
        save_persistent_mob( curr_ai->character, true );
        return;
    }

        return FALSE;
    
    if ( !pArea )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "That area doesn't exist." );
        return FALSE;
    }
    
    if ( get_trust( ch ) >= LEVEL_ADMIN )
        return TRUE;

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
        return FALSE;

    if ( is_name( "room", ch->pcdata->bestowments ) || is_name( "area", ch->pcdata->bestowments ) )
        return TRUE;
    
    if ( !NULLSTR( pArea->builders ) && is_name( ch->name, pArea->builders ) )
        return TRUE;

    ch_println( ch, "You're not an authorized builder in that area." );
    return FALSE;

CMDF do_rdesc( CHAR_DATA* ch, char* argument __attribute__((unused)) )
{
    BUFFER_DATA* buffer = NULL;

    if ( IS_NPC( ch ) )
        return;

    if ( is_busy( ch ) )
    {
        ch_println( ch, "You are too busy to do that right now." );
        return;
    }

    if ( !ch->in_room )
    {
        bug( "%s: %s no longer in room", FUNC, ch->name );
        return;
    }

    switch ( ch->substate )
    {
        default:
            bug( "%s: illegal substate", FUNC );
            return;

        case SUB_RESTRICTED:
            ch_println( ch, "You cannot use this command from within another command." );
            return;

        case SUB_NONE:
            ch->substate = SUB_ROOM_DESC;
            buffer = create_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            start_editing( ch, FUNC, ch->in_room->description );
            return;

        case SUB_ROOM_DESC:
            buffer = get_buffer( ch, FUNC );
            if ( !buffer )
            {
                stop_editing( ch, false );
                return;
            }
            dispose_buffer( buffer );
            SET_STRING( ch->in_room->description, copy_buffer( ch ) );
            stop_editing( ch, false );
            save_room( ch->in_room, true );
            return;
    }
}

This document outlines the architecture of the BB-8 bot, a modular AI agent system for LotJ that builds upon the existing R2D2Bot framework.

## Overview

BB-8 is a modular AI assistant that implements:
1. Chain of thought reasoning
2. Tool use capabilities
3. Vector-based memory system

The architecture separates concerns into independent modules that work together through well-defined interfaces.

## Proxy Objects

LotJ uses a proxy object system to safely interact with MUD data structures. This provides:
1. Safety - Prevents direct manipulation of MUD memory
2. Validation - Ensures objects still exist before operations
3. Journaling - Tracks changes for rollback on errors

Example proxy methods:
```lua
local room = Room.findByVNum(1200)
local ch = Character.findByName("Luke")
ch:toRoom(room)  -- Uses proxy objects for safe room transfer
```

## Safety and Memory Management

The Lua system includes:
1. **Memory limits** - Each program has a maximum allocation
2. **Time limits** - Prevents infinite loops
3. **Error handling** - Catches and logs errors without crashing
4. **Journaling** - Tracks changes for rollback on failures

## Unsafe Operations

Some operations require direct access to MUD structures:
```lua
-- Enable unsafe mode globally
LOTJ.unsafe(true)
Character.damage(ch, victim, 100)

-- Or for a single operation
LOTJ.unsafe(Character.damage, ch, victim, 100)
```

Unsafe operations:
1. Commit the journal before execution
2. Verify all pointers are still valid
3. Execute the unsafe function
4. Resume journaling afterward

## Extending the Lua System

New C libraries should:
1. Follow the proxy object pattern
2. Implement proper error handling
3. Support journaling for state changes
4. Validate all pointers before use
5. Provide clear documentation

### Library Structure

```c
// Include necessary headers
#include "mud.h"
#include "lua_header.h"

// Function declarations
static int my_lua_function(lua_State *L);

// Library registration
static const struct luaL_Reg mylib_f [] = {
    {"myFunction", my_lua_function},
    {NULL, NULL}
};

// Library initialization
int luaopen_mymodule(lua_State* L) {
    // Create metatable
    luaL_newmetatable(L, "LOTJ_MyModule");
    
    // Set up functions
    luaL_setfuncs(L, mylib_f, 0);
    
    // Make it globally available
    lua_setglobal(L, "MyModule");
    
    return 1;
}
```

# Event System in LotJ Lua

The event system is a core component of LotJ's Lua architecture, allowing scripts to respond to game events and triggers.

## Overview

The event system provides a way for Lua code to:
1. Register interest in specific types of events
2. Define callback functions that execute when events occur
3. Perform actions in response to game events

## Trigger Types

The system supports various trigger types, categorized by their subject:

### Room Triggers
- `ROOM_ON_RANDOM` - Random room triggers
- `ROOM_ON_TIME` - Time-based room events
- `ROOM_ON_ACT` - When an action happens in the room
- `ROOM_ON_SPEECH` - When someone speaks in the room
- `ROOM_ON_ENTER` - When someone enters the room
- `ROOM_ON_LEAVE` - When someone leaves the room
- `ROOM_ON_LOOK` - When someone looks at the room
- `ROOM_ON_DROP` - When an object is dropped in the room
- `ROOM_ON_COMMAND` - When a command is executed in the room

### Object Triggers
- `OBJ_ON_RANDOM` - Random object triggers
- `OBJ_ON_TIME` - Time-based object events
- `OBJ_ON_ACT` - When an action happens near the object
- `OBJ_ON_SPEECH` - When someone speaks near the object
- `OBJ_ON_GREET` - When someone comes near the object
- `OBJ_ON_WEAR` - When the object is worn
- `OBJ_ON_REMOVE` - When the object is removed
- `OBJ_ON_EXAMINE` - When the object is examined
- `OBJ_ON_GET` - When the object is picked up
- `OBJ_ON_DROP` - When the object is dropped
- `OBJ_ON_DAMAGE` - When the object is damaged
- `OBJ_ON_PULL` - When the object is pulled
- `OBJ_ON_PUSH` - When the object is pushed
- `OBJ_ON_USE` - When the object is used
- `OBJ_ON_COMMAND` - When a command is used on the object

### Character Triggers
- `CH_ON_DEATH` - When a character dies
- `CH_ON_FIGHT` - When a character fights
- `CH_ON_DAMAGE` - When a character takes damage
- `CH_ON_ACT` - When an action happens to/by the character
- `CH_ON_SPEECH` - When someone speaks near the character
- `CH_ON_GREET` - When someone approaches the character
- `CH_ON_ENTER` - When the character enters a room
- `CH_ON_RANDOM` - Random character triggers
- `CH_ON_TIME` - Time-based character events
- `CH_ON_GIVE` - When something is given to the character
- `CH_ON_BRIBE` - When the character is bribed
- `CH_ON_LOOK` - When someone looks at the character
- `CH_ON_SPAWNED` - When the character spawns
- `CH_ON_SAYTO` - When someone directly addresses the character

### Ship Triggers
- `SHIP_ON_TARGETED` - When a ship is targeted
- `SHIP_ON_DESTROYED` - When a ship is destroyed
- `SHIP_ON_SPAWNED` - When a ship spawns
- `SHIP_ON_TICK` - Periodic ship updates
- `SHIP_ON_CREATE` - When a ship is created
- `SHIP_ON_LAUNCH` - When a ship launches
- `SHIP_ON_LAUNCHED` - After a ship has launched
- `SHIP_ON_LAND` - When a ship lands
- `SHIP_ON_LANDED` - After a ship has landed
- `SHIP_ON_HYPER` - When a ship enters hyperspace
- `SHIP_ON_HYPER_EXIT` - When a ship exits hyperspace
- `SHIP_ON_DOCK` - When a ship docks
- `SHIP_ON_DOCKED` - After a ship has docked
- `SHIP_ON_UNDOCK` - When a ship undocks
- `SHIP_ON_UNDOCKED` - After a ship has undocked

### Global Triggers
- `FIREHOSE_MSG` - When a firehose message is generated
- `MQTT_ON_MESSAGE` - When an MQTT message is received
- `CH_ON_INFO` - Character information events
- `CH_ON_LOGIN` - When a character logs in
- `CH_ON_LOGOUT` - When a character logs out
- `DISCORD_ON_COMMAND` - When a Discord command is received

## Registering Triggers

Triggers are registered using the appropriate module functions:

```lua
-- Register a room entry trigger
Room.onEnter(room, function(ch)
  ch:echoAt("Welcome to " .. room:getName())
end)

-- Register a character login trigger
Character.onLogin(nil, function(ch, room)
  ch:echoAt("Welcome back, " .. ch:getName())
end)

-- Register an object use trigger
Object.onUse(obj, function(ch, obj)
  ch:echoAt("You use " .. obj:getShortDesc())
  return true -- Prevent standard use behavior
end)
```

The first parameter is typically the subject of the trigger (the room, character, object, etc.) or `nil` for global triggers. The second parameter is the callback function that will be executed when the event occurs.

## Callback Functions

Callbacks receive context-specific parameters:

```lua
-- Room entry callback receives the character entering
Room.onEnter(room, function(ch)
  -- 'ch' is the character entering the room
end)

-- Ship destroyed callback receives ship and attacker details
Ship.onDestroyed(ship, function(ship, attacker_ship, attacker_ch)
  -- 'ship' is the destroyed ship
  -- 'attacker_ship' is the attacking ship (if any)
  -- 'attacker_ch' is the attacking character (if any)
end)
```

## Return Values

Some callbacks can return values to control behavior:

```lua
-- Return true to override standard behavior
Room.onCommand(room, function(ch, command, argument)
  if command == "special" then
    ch:echoAt("You performed a special command!")
    return true -- Prevent standard command processing
  end
  return false -- Allow standard command processing
end)
```

## Trigger Execution Order

When multiple triggers match an event:
1. Global triggers execute first
2. Subject-specific triggers execute next
3. Within each category, triggers execute in registration order

## Delayed Triggers

Triggers can be scheduled to execute later:

```lua
Timer.create(5, function()
  ch:echoAt("This message appears 5 seconds later")
end)
```

## Best Practices

1. **Be Specific**: Register triggers on specific entities when possible, rather than global triggers
2. **Keep Callbacks Light**: Avoid heavy processing in frequently triggered callbacks
3. **Handle Errors**: Use pcall for operations that might fail
4. **Validate Entities**: Check that entities still exist within your callbacks
5. **Return Early**: Exit callbacks early when conditions aren't met
6. **Limit Side Effects**: Minimize world changes in information callbacks
7. **Use Return Values**: Return true/false appropriately to control standard behavior

# Looms in LotJ

Looms are Lua script files used in the LotJ MUD environment that can function either as libraries or standalone programs.

## What are Looms?

Looms are `.loom` files that contain Lua code that can be:

1. **Libraries** - Code modules that can be included by other Lua programs
2. **Programs** - Standalone code that runs in response to specific events

All looms are stored in the `/looms` directory and have a `.loom` file extension.

## Loom File Format

Looms have a specific format:

```
#LOOM_HEADER
Author         <author>~
CreatedAt      <timestamp>
UpdatedBy      <last_editor>~
UpdatedAt      <timestamp>
Enabled        <1/0>
Attachment <type> <vnum/identifier> <optional_label>
Flags          <flags>
End
<lua code>
```

Key components:
- **Author**: The original creator
- **CreatedAt**: Unix timestamp of creation
- **UpdatedBy**: Last person to modify
- **UpdatedAt**: Timestamp of last update
- **Enabled**: Whether the loom is active (1) or disabled (0)
- **Attachment**: Optional links to game entities (rooms, objects, mobs, ship templates)
- **Flags**: Special properties ("library", "privileged")
- **Lua code**: The actual script content

## Types of Looms

### Library Looms

Library looms provide reusable functionality for other programs. They:
- Have the "library" flag set
- Can be included with `Loom.include("library_name.loom")`
- Are loaded into memory but don't execute until included

Example library:
```lua
-- A simple library to format credits
local function formatCredits(amount)
  return string.format("%d credit%s", amount, amount == 1 and "" or "s")
end

-- Return the function to include in other programs
return formatCredits
```

### Program Looms

Program looms are standalone scripts that:
- Do not have the "library" flag
- Are attached to specific entities (rooms, mobs, objects, ship templates)
- Execute in response to specific events
- Automatically initialize and register triggers

Example program:
```lua
-- A loom that triggers when someone enters a room
Character.onEnter(nil, function(ch)
  ch:echoAt("Welcome to this special room!")
end)
```

## Attaching Looms

Looms can be attached to:
1. **Rooms** - Execute when room events happen
2. **Objects** - Execute when object events happen
3. **Mobs** - Execute when mob events happen
4. **Ship Templates** - Execute when ship template events happen

Attachments have the following format:
```
Attachment <type> <vnum/identifier> <optional_label>
```

Where:
- **type**: room, obj, mob, or ship_template
- **vnum/identifier**: The room/object/mob vnum or ship template name
- **label**: Optional label for identification

## Including Looms

Library looms can be included in other Lua programs:

```lua
local myLibrary = Loom.include("library_name.loom")
```

The system:
1. Checks if the loom is already loaded (and returns the cached result if it is)
2. Verifies the library exists
3. Checks for circular inclusions
4. Loads and executes the library code
5. Returns whatever the library's code returns
6. Caches the result for future inclusions

## Privileged Looms

Looms with the "privileged" flag have special permissions:
- Can only be included by other privileged programs
- Can perform operations that normal looms cannot
- Can only be edited by administrators

## Managing Looms

The `loom` command provides tools to manage looms:

```
loom list                 # List all looms
loom show <filename>      # Display loom code
loom create <filename>    # Create a new loom
loom edit <filename>      # Edit a loom
loom delete <filename>    # Delete a loom
loom enable <filename>    # Enable a loom
loom disable <filename>   # Disable a loom
loom reload <filename>    # Reload a loom and all dependent programs
loom logs <filename>      # View loom logs
loom flags <filename>     # View/edit loom flags
loom attach <filename>    # Attach loom to a game entity
loom detach <filename>    # Detach loom from a game entity
```

## Best Practices

1. **Organization**:
   - Use libraries for shared code
   - Keep programs focused on specific tasks

2. **Naming**:
   - Use descriptive filenames
   - Include purpose in library names
   - Consider using prefixes for categorization

3. **Safety**:
   - Validate all inputs
   - Use local variables to avoid scope pollution
   - Handle errors gracefully

4. **Performance**:
   - Keep libraries small and efficient
   - Avoid expensive operations in frequently triggered code
   - Use appropriate event triggers

5. **Documentation**:
   - Comment your code
   - Describe the purpose of libraries
   - Document function parameters and return values

## Example Usage

### Creating a Library

```lua
-- utilities.loom
local utilities = {}

utilities.formatCredits = function(amount)
  return string.format("%d credit%s", amount, amount == 1 and "" or "s")
end

utilities.isJedi = function(ch)
  return ch:getLevel("jedi") > 0
end

return utilities
```

### Using a Library

```lua
-- jedi_welcome.loom
local utilities = Loom.include("utilities.loom")

Character.onEnter(nil, function(ch)
  if utilities.isJedi(ch) then
    ch:echoAt("Welcome, Jedi Master!")
  else
    ch:echoAt("Welcome, traveler!")
  end
end)
```

# LotJ Lua Architecture

This document outlines the architecture and key components of the Lua system in LotJ (Legends of the Jedi MUD).

## Core Concepts

### The Lua Layer

The Lua implementation in LotJ follows three fundamental laws:

1. The Lua layer must never crash the MUD
2. The Lua layer must never cause any state changes in the event of an error
3. The Lua layer must be easy to use (on the Lua side)

### Components Overview

The Lua system consists of two main component types:

1. **Core Libraries** (`src/lua_*.c` files) - The C-side implementation that exposes MUD functionality to Lua
2. **Looms** (`.loom` files) - Lua scripts that can be loaded as libraries or standalone programs

## Core Libraries

Core libraries are C files (with a `lua_` prefix) that expose MUD functionality to Lua. They provide:

- Bindings to MUD data structures (characters, objects, rooms, etc.)
- Event and trigger systems
- Safety mechanisms
- Utility functions
- Database interfaces

Key libraries include:

- `lua_core.c` - Core functionality and program management
- `lua_ch.c` - Character interactions
- `lua_obj.c` - Object interactions
- `lua_room.c` - Room interactions
- `lua_loom.c` - Management of Loom libraries/programs
- `lua_trigger.c` - Event triggers and callbacks
- `lua_rocksdb.c` - Persistent storage

### Proxy Objects

The Lua layer uses proxy objects to safely access MUD data structures. This prevents direct manipulation of critical MUD data structures, maintaining safety and stability.

### Unsafe Operations

Some operations require direct access to MUD structures. These are handled through an "unsafe" mode:

1. **Global Unsafe Mode**: Enable with `LOTJ.unsafe(true)`. Once enabled, it cannot be disabled.
2. **Single Call Unsafe Mode**: Enable for a single call with `LOTJ.unsafe(function, args...)`.

Unsafe operations are carefully controlled by:
- Committing the current journal before unsafe operations
- Validating all pointers to ensure they are still valid
- Warning developers about potential risks

## Looms

Looms are Lua scripts that can function as:

1. **Libraries** - Code that can be included by other Lua programs
2. **Programs** - Standalone code that runs on specific events or triggers

### Loom Architecture

Looms have a consistent file format:

```
#LOOM_HEADER
Author         <author>~
CreatedAt      <timestamp>
UpdatedBy      <last_editor>~
UpdatedAt      <timestamp>
Enabled        <1/0>
Attachment <type> <vnum/identifier> <optional_label>
Flags          <flags>
End
<lua code>
```

Where:
- **Flags** can include "library" and "privileged"
- **Attachment** can link the loom to rooms, objects, mobs, or ship templates

### Including Looms

Looms marked as libraries can be included in other Lua programs:

```lua
Loom.include("library_name.loom")
```

The system provides mechanisms to prevent circular inclusion and track dependencies.

### Loom Loading & Execution

1. Looms are loaded from the `looms` directory at startup
2. Library looms are made available for inclusion
3. Program looms are:
   - Attached to their specified targets (rooms, objects, etc.)
   - Executed when triggered by events
   - Managed by the trigger system

## Event System

The event system allows Lua code to respond to in-game events. Events are triggered by:

1. **Time-based events** - Called at specific intervals
2. **Game events** - Called on specific game actions (room entry, object use, etc.)
3. **Command events** - Called in response to player commands

Triggers are registered with callbacks, which are Lua functions that get executed when the event occurs.

## Memory and Safety

The Lua system incorporates several safety mechanisms:

1. **Memory limits** - Programs have a maximum memory allocation
2. **Execution time limits** - Prevents infinite loops
3. **Journaling** - All state changes are journaled and only committed if the script completes successfully
4. **Privilege levels** - Only certain programs can perform sensitive operations

## Persistent Storage

Lua programs can use RocksDB for persistent storage. This provides:

1. ACID-compliant key-value storage
2. Transaction support
3. Isolation between different programs

## Management Interface

The `loom` command provides an administrative interface to:

1. Create, edit, and delete looms
2. Enable/disable looms
3. View logs and status
4. Attach/detach looms to game entities
5. Reload looms and associated programs

## Best Practices

1. Prefer libraries for shared code
2. Use the unsafe mode sparingly
3. Always validate inputs
4. Handle errors gracefully
5. Keep programs modular and focused
6. Use the journaling system for safety
7. Minimize memory usage

#define CREATE(result, type, number)                    \
    do                                          \
    {                                           \
        if (!((result) = (type *) calloc ((number), sizeof(type)))) \
        {                                           \
            perror("malloc failure");                       \
            fprintf(stderr, "Malloc failure @ %s:%d\n", __FILE__, __LINE__ ); \
            abort();                                    \
        }       \
    } while(0)

// Allocate a chunk of memory based only on its size. Use when you know the size, but not the type.
#define CREATE_RAW(result, size) \
    do { \
        if (!((result) = (void*)calloc(1, size))) \
        { \
            perror("malloc failure"); \
            fprintf(stderr, "Malloc failure @ %s:%d\n", __FILE__, __LINE__ ); \
            abort(); \
        } \
    } while(0)

            fprintf(stderr, "Realloc failure @ %s:%d\n", __FILE__, __LINE__ ); \
            abort();                                    \
        }                                           \

#define LINK(link, first, last, next, prev)                     \
    do                                                              \
    {                                                               \
        if ( !(first) )                                             \
            (first)                   = (link);                       \
        else                                                        \
            (last)->next              = (link);                       \
        (link)->next                = NULL;                         \
        (link)->prev                = (last);                       \
        (last)                      = (link);                       \
    } while(0)
#define PROX_LINK(link, first, last, next, prev, getprox)                     \
    do                                                              \
    {                                                               \
        if ( !(first) )                                             \
            (first)                   = (link)->_source;                       \
        else                                                        \
            (getprox)((last))->next              = (link)->_source;                       \
        (link)->next                = NULL;                         \
        (link)->prev                = (last);                       \
        (last)                      = (link)->_source;                       \
    } while(0)

        (link)->prev = (insert)->prev;            \
        if ( !(insert)->prev )                              \
            (first) = (link)->_source;                                \
        else                                                         \
            (getprox)((insert)->prev)->next = (link)->_source;        \
        (insert)->prev = (link)->_source;                            \
        (link)->next = (insert)->_source;                            \
    } while(0)

// Macro for iterating over cases of our LNODE linked list pattern
// Assumes that the LNODE type is <underlying type>_LNODE (as in AREA_DATA_LNODE for AREA_DATA)
// value_name is the variable name you want to use to access the current element while in the loop
// Supports elements being removed as we iterate over the list.
#define FOREACH_LNODE(value_type, first, value_name, action) \
    for ( value_type##_LNODE *_iter = first, *_next = NULL; _iter; _iter = _next ) \
    { \
        _next = _iter->next; \
        value_type* value_name = _iter->value; \
        if ( 1 ) { action; } \
    }

#define LINK_LNODE(lnode_type, value_to_add, first, last) \
    do { \
        lnode_type* lnode; \
        CREATE( lnode, lnode_type, 1 ); \
        lnode->value = value_to_add; \
        LINK( lnode, first, last, next, prev ); \
    } while (0)

#define UNLINK_LNODE(lnode_type, value_to_remove, first, last) \
    do { \
        lnode_type* l_next; \
        for ( lnode_type* l = first; l; l = l_next ) { \
            l_next = l->next; \
            if ( l->value == value_to_remove ) { \
                UNLINK( l, first, last, next, prev ); \
                DISPOSE( l ); \
            } \
        } \
    } while (0)

#define LINK_SORT_NAME(link, type, first, last, next, prev, comp)   \
    do                                                              \
    {                                                               \
        if ( !(first) )                                             \
            LINK( (link), (first), (last), next, prev );            \
        else                                                        \
        {                                                           \
            type *iter = NULL;                                      \
            for ( iter = (first); iter; iter = iter->next)          \
                if ( !iter->next || strcasecmp( iter->next->comp, (link)->comp ) > 0 )    \
                    break;                                          \
            if ( strcasecmp( iter->comp, (link)->comp ) < 0 )       \
                INSERT_AFTER( (link), iter, (last), next, prev );   \
            else                                                    \
                INSERT( (link), iter, (first), next, prev );        \
        }                                                           \
    } while(0)

#define LINK_SORT_NUM(link, type, first, last, next, prev, comp)    \
    do                                                              \
    {                                                               \
        if ( !(first) )                                             \
            LINK( (link), (first), (last), next, prev );            \
        else                                                        \
        {                                                           \
            type *iter = NULL;                                      \
            for ( iter = (first); iter; iter = iter->next)          \
                if ( !iter->next || iter->next->comp > (link)->comp )  \
                    break;                                          \
            if ( iter->comp < (link)->comp )                        \
                INSERT_AFTER( (link), iter, (last), next, prev );   \
            else                                                    \
                INSERT( (link), iter, (first), next, prev );        \
        }                                                           \
    } while(0)

// Create an array of pointers from a linked list
// link: head element of the list
// type: type of elements in the list
// next: variable name pointing to the next element
// array: variable, pointer to an array of pointers of type <type>, in which to set the result
#define LINK_TO_ARRAY(link, type, next, array)                      \
    do                                                              \
    {                                                               \
        int length = 1;                                             \
        type *iter;                                                 \
        for (iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next)                \
            length++;                                               \
        if ((array))                                                \
            free((array));                                          \
        (array) = (type **)malloc(length * sizeof(type *));         \
        int i = 0;                                                  \
        for ( iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next )              \
        {                                                           \
            (array)[i] = iter;                                      \
            i++;                                                    \
        }                                                           \
        (array)[i] = NULL;                                          \
    } while(0)

// Sorts an array of pointers
// array: the array of pointers
// type: type of elements in the array
// func: the sorting function to use
// cond: variable for comparison
#define SORT_ARRAY(array, type, func, cond )                        \
    do                                                              \
    {                                                               \
        int i = 0, j = 0, min_idx = 0;                              \
        for (i = 0; (array)[i]; i++)                                \
        {                                                           \
            min_idx = i;                                            \
            for ( j = i + 1; (array)[j]; j++ )                      \
                if ( !(func)((array)[j]->cond, (array)[min_idx]->cond ) )      \
                    min_idx = j;                                    \
            type* temp = (array)[min_idx];                          \
            (array)[min_idx] = (array)[i];                          \
            (array)[i] = temp;                                      \
        }                                                           \
    } while(0)

// Set count to the number of elements in the given list.
// link: head element
// type: type of elements
// next: variable name pointing to the next element
// count: integer in which to set the resulting value
#define LINK_LENGTH(link, type, next, count) \
    { \
        (count) = 0; \
        for ( type *iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next) \
            ++(count); \
    }

// Increment count by the number of elements in the given list.
// link: head element
// type: type of elements
// next: variable name pointing to the next element
// count: integer in which to set the resulting value
#define LINK_LENGTH_INCREM(link, type, next, count) \
    { \
        for ( type *iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next) \
            ++(count); \
    }

// Find the Nth element of a linked list
// link: head element
// type: type of elements
// next: variable name pointing to the next element
// index: element index to look for, 0-based
// result: variable, pointer to <type>, in which to set the result. NULL if index out of bounds.
#define LINK_LOOKUP(link, type, next, index, result) \
    { \
        (result) = NULL; \
        int ctr = 0; \
        for ( type *iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next) \
        { \
            if ( ctr == (index) ) \
            { \
                (result) = iter; \
                break; \
            } \
            ctr++; \
        } \
    }

// Find the index of the given element in the given linked list.
// link: head element
// type: type of elements
// next: variable name pointing to the next element
// element: pointer of type <type> which we're looking for in the list
// result: integer to set the resulting index in, or -1 if not found
#define LINK_INDEXOF(link, type, next, element, result) \
    { \
        int ctr = 0; \
        (result) = -1; \
        for ( type *iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next) \
        { \
            if ( iter == (element) ) \
            { \
                (result) = ctr; \
                break; \
            } \
            ctr++; \
        } \
    }

// Check if the given element exists as a node in the given linked list.
// link: head element
// type: type of elements
// next: variable name pointing to the next element
// element: pointer of type <type> which we're looking for in the list
// result: boolean to set as true if the element is found, or false if not
#define LINK_HASNODE(link, type, next, element, result) \
    { \
        (result) = FALSE; \
        for ( type *iter = (link); iter; iter = iter->next) \
        { \
            if ( iter == (element) ) \
            { \
                (result) = TRUE; \
                break; \
            } \
        } \
    }

#define CHECK_LINKS(first, last, next, prev, type)      \
    do {                                \
        type *ptr, *pptr = NULL;                  \
        if ( !(first) && !(last) )                    \
            break;                          \
        if ( !(first) )                       \
        {                             \
            bug( "CHECK_LINKS: last with NULL first!  %s.",     \
                 __STRING(first) );                  \
            for ( ptr = (last); ptr->prev; ptr = ptr->prev );       \
            (first) = ptr;                      \
        }                             \
        else if ( !(last) )                       \
        {                             \
            bug( "CHECK_LINKS: first with NULL last!  %s.",     \
                 __STRING(first) );                  \
            for ( ptr = (first); ptr->next; ptr = ptr->next );      \
            (last) = ptr;                       \
        }                             \
        if ( (first) )                        \
        {                             \
            for ( ptr = (first); ptr; ptr = ptr->next )         \
            {                               \
                if ( ptr->prev != pptr )                  \
                {                             \
                    bug( "CHECK_LINKS(%s): %p:->prev != %p.  Fixing.",  \
                         __STRING(first), ptr, pptr );           \
                    ptr->prev = pptr;                   \
                }                             \
                if ( ptr->prev && ptr->prev->next != ptr )        \
                {                             \
                    bug( "CHECK_LINKS(%s): %p:->prev->next != %p.  Fixing.",\
                         __STRING(first), ptr, ptr );            \
                    ptr->prev->next = ptr;                  \
                }                             \
                pptr = ptr;                       \
            }                               \
            pptr = NULL;                        \
        }                             \
        if ( (last) )                         \
        {                             \
            for ( ptr = (last); ptr; ptr = ptr->prev )          \
            {                               \
                if ( ptr->next != pptr )                  \
                {                             \
                    bug( "CHECK_LINKS (%s): %p:->next != %p.  Fixing.", \
                         __STRING(first), ptr, pptr );           \
                    ptr->next = pptr;                   \
                }                             \
                if ( ptr->next && ptr->next->prev != ptr )        \
                {                             \
                    bug( "CHECK_LINKS(%s): %p:->next->prev != %p.  Fixing.",\
                         __STRING(first), ptr, ptr );            \
                    ptr->next->prev = ptr;                  \
                }                             \
                pptr = ptr;                       \
            }                               \
        }                             \
    } while(0)

#define IS_SWITCHED_PC(ch) (!xIS_SET( (ch)->act, ACT_IS_NPC ) && ((ch)->switched != NULL || (ch)->pcdata != NULL || ((ch)->desc != NULL && (ch)->desc->original == (ch))))
#define IS_SWITCHED_NPC(ch) (xIS_SET( (ch)->act, ACT_IS_NPC ) && ((ch)->switched != NULL || (ch)->pcdata != NULL ))
#define IS_PUFF(ch)     (IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pIndexData && (ch)->pIndexData->vnum == MOB_VNUM_PUFF)
#define IS_ANIMAL(ch)           (xIS_SET((ch)->act, ACT_IS_NPC) && xIS_SET((ch)->act, ACT_ANIMAL ))
#define IS_IMMORTAL(ch)     (get_trust((ch)) >= LEVEL_IMMORTAL)
#define IS_RPC(ch)              (get_trust((ch)) >= LEVEL_RPC )
#define IS_HERO(ch)     (get_trust((ch)) >= LEVEL_HERO)
#define IS_AFFECTED(ch, sn) (xIS_SET((ch)->affected_by, (sn)))
#define IS_SNEAKING(ch) (IS_AFFECTED((ch), AFF_SNEAK) && !IS_AFFECTED((ch), AFF_VISIBLE))
#define IS_CONTROLLED(ch) (IS_NPC((ch)) && IS_AFFECTED((ch), AFF_CHARM) && (ch)->master && !IS_NPC((ch)->master))

#define GET_TIME_PLAYED(ch)     (((ch)->played + (current_time - (ch)->logon)) / 3600)

#define CH(descriptor)  ((descriptor)->original ? (descriptor)->original : (descriptor)->character)

#define IS_GOOD(ch)     ((ch)->alignment >= 300 ) // Gral all force skills use  300 for cut off was  350
#define IS_EVIL(ch)     ((ch)->alignment <= -300) // Gral all force skills use -300 for cut off was -350
#define IS_NEUTRAL(ch)      (!IS_GOOD(ch) && !IS_EVIL(ch))

#define IS_AWAKE(ch)        ((ch)->position > POS_SLEEPING)
#define IS_JEDI(ch)            (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->frank > FRANK_NONE && IS_GOOD((ch)))
#define IS_SITH(ch)            (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->frank > FRANK_NONE && IS_EVIL((ch)))
#define IS_GUARDIAN(ch)        (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->fclass == JEDI_GUARDIAN)
#define IS_SENTINEL(ch)        (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->fclass == JEDI_SENTINEL)
#define IS_CONSULAR(ch)        (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->fclass == JEDI_CONSULAR)
#define IS_JUGGERNAUT(ch)        (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->fclass == SITH_JUGGERNAUT)
#define IS_ASSASSIN(ch)        (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->fclass == SITH_ASSASSIN)
#define IS_SORCERER(ch)        (!IS_NPC((ch)) && (ch)->pcdata->fclass == SITH_SORCERER)

#define GET_AC(ch)              (get_new_ac(ch))

#define GET_DAMROLL(ch)     ((ch)->damroll                              \

                             +(((ch)->mental_state > 5           \

#define IS_OUTSIDE(ch)      (!xIS_SET(                   \
                             (ch)->in_room->flags,          \
                             ROOM_INDOORS) && !xIS_SET(               \
                                     (ch)->in_room->flags,              \
                                     ROOM_SPACECRAFT) )

#define IS_DRUNK(ch, drunk)     (number_percent() < \
                                 ( (ch)->pcdata->condition[COND_DRUNK] \
                                   * 2 / (drunk) ) )

#define IS_CLANNED(ch)      (!IS_NPC((ch))                  \
                             && (ch)->pcdata->clan               )

#define WAIT_STATE(ch, npulse)  ((ch)->wait = get_trust(ch) >= sysdata.log_level ? 0 : UMAX((ch)->wait, (npulse)))


#define EXIT(ch, door)      ( get_exit( (ch)->in_room, door ) )

#define CAN_GO(ch, exit)    ((exit)           \
                             && ((exit)->to_room != NULL)  \
                             && !xIS_SET((exit)->flags, EX_CLOSED))

#define IS_VALID_SN(sn)     ( (sn) > 0 && (sn) < last_skill->id )

#define IS_QUESTOR(ch)     (has_pcflag((ch), PCFLAG_QUESTOR))

#define SPELL_FLAG(skill, flag) ( IS_SET((skill)->flags, (flag)) )
#define SPELL_DAMAGE(skill) ( ((skill)->flags ) & 7 )
#define SPELL_ACTION(skill) ( ((skill)->flags >> 3) & 7 )
#define SPELL_CLASS(skill)  ( ((skill)->flags >> 6) & 7 )
#define SPELL_POWER(skill)  ( ((skill)->flags >> 9) & 3 )
#define SET_SDAM(skill, val)    ( (skill)->flags =  ((skill)->flags & SDAM_MASK) + ((val) & 7) )
#define SET_SACT(skill, val)    ( (skill)->flags =  ((skill)->flags & SACT_MASK) + (((val) & 7) << 3) )
#define SET_SCLA(skill, val)    ( (skill)->flags =  ((skill)->flags & SCLA_MASK) + (((val) & 7) << 6) )
#define SET_SPOW(skill, val)    ( (skill)->flags =  ((skill)->flags & SPOW_MASK) + (((val) & 3) << 9) )
